youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🧖 實用水療一日必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡800句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A Day at the Spa
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用水療一日情境對話：從打電話約九十分鐘的時段、問清楚桑拿與蒸氣室分別在哪一區、換袍子與寄物櫃、桑拿裡的規矩、第一次冷水浸泡、喝熱茶休息、進臉部按摩間，到做完躺著不想起。每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫，800 句（400 對）循環聽，不用背、不用看畫面，睡覺聽就會。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical A Day at the Spa phrase pairs — booking a ninety-minute session, the sauna and steam rooms, the robe and locker, cold plunge first-timers, tea breaks, the facial room and the slow walk home. Each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue. 800 lines (400 pairs), CEFR A2, no memorizing needed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, may I speak with the front desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd ˌæftərˈnun meɪ aɪ spiːk wɪð ðə frʌnt dɛsk?/
dialogue.zh: 午安，我想請櫃台接一下電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is the desk, how can I help?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz ðə dɛsk haʊ kæn aɪ hɛlp?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡就是櫃台，需要什麼幫忙？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to book the ninety-minute package.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tə bʊk ðə ˈnaɪnti ˈmɪnɪt ˈpækɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 我想預約九十分鐘的那一套。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good pick, it fills a slow afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd pɪk ɪt fɪlz ə sloʊ ˌæftərˈnun./
dialogue.zh: 選得好，剛剛夠填一個悠閒的下午。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is four thirty still free this Sunday?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz fɔr ˈθɜrdi stɪl fri ðɪs ˈsʌndeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 這週日四點半還空著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunday keeps one spot, would you take it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌndeɪ kips wʌn spɑt wʊd ju teɪk ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 週日只剩一個名額，你要嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, please hold that slot in my name.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliːz hoʊld ðæt slɑt ɪn maɪ neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 好，請用我的名字留下那個時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: May I have your first name, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ hæv jɔr fɜrst neɪm pliːz?/
dialogue.zh: 可以請教您的名字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just Lin, spelled L I N.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst lɪn spɛld ɛl aɪ ɛn./
dialogue.zh: 就叫我林，拼法是 L、I、N。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lovely, and is this your first visit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌvli ænd ɪz ðɪs jɔr fɜrst ˈvɪzɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 好的，這是您第一次來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's my first time at a real spa.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts maɪ fɜrst taɪm æt ə ril spɑ./
dialogue.zh: 我頭一回進這麼正式的水療中心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First timers walk the rooms with us.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst ˈtaɪmərz wɔk ðə rumz wɪθ ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 第一次來的人，我們會帶著走一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to bring my own towel?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə brɪŋ maɪ oʊn ˈtaʊəl?/
dialogue.zh: 我需要自備毛巾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We hand you two towels and a robe.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hænd ju tu ˈtaʊəlz ænd ə roʊb./
dialogue.zh: 我們會給你兩條毛巾和一件袍子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring my own slippers too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ brɪŋ maɪ oʊn ˈslɪpərz tu?/
dialogue.zh: 拖鞋也要自己帶一雙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft slippers already wait in your locker.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft ˈslɪpərz ɔlˈrɛdi weɪt ɪn jɔr ˈlɑkər./
dialogue.zh: 軟拖鞋已經先放在你的櫃子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How deep is the cold plunge pool?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ diːp ɪz ðə koʊld plʌndʒ pul?/
dialogue.zh: 冷水池大約有多深？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It reaches your shoulders, never your chin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈritʃɪz jɔr ˈʃoʊldərz ˈnɛvər jɔr tʃɪn./
dialogue.zh: 水會到你的肩，絕不到下巴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the sauna a shared room, or mine alone?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈsaʊnə ə ʃɛrd rum ɔr maɪn əˈloʊn./
dialogue.zh: 桑拿是跟大家共用的房間，還是只有我一個人？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sauna seat holds eight guests at once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsaʊnə sit hoʊldz eɪt ɡɛsts æt wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 桑拿的座位一次坐得下八個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a quiet room for a nap?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ə ˈkwaɪət rum fɔr ə næp?/
dialogue.zh: 你們有可以午睡的靜室嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tea lounge upstairs is the quiet one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ti laʊndʒ ˌʌpˈstɛrz ɪz ðə ˈkwaɪət wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 樓上的喝茶區就是安靜的那一間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the ninety-minute package cost?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʌz ðə ˈnaɪnti ˈmɪnɪt ˈpækɪdʒ kɑst?/
dialogue.zh: 九十分鐘那一套要多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eighty dollars, with the tea lounge free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈeɪti ˈdɑlərz wɪð ðə ti laʊndʒ fri./
dialogue.zh: 八十元，喝茶區不用再收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay now, or when I leave?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ peɪ naʊ ɔr wɛn aɪ liv?/
dialogue.zh: 我是現在付，還是走的時候付？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small deposit online, then the rest there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl dɪˈpɑzɪt ˌɑnˈlaɪn ðɛn ðə rɛst ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 線上先付一點訂金，剩下的到場再付。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I cancel if I wake up sick?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈkænsl ɪf aɪ weɪk ʌp sɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我那天起床身體不舒服，能取消嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call two hours ahead, no charge at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl tu ˈaʊərz əˈhɛd noʊ tʃɑrdʒ æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 提前兩小時打來，就半毛錢都不收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you text me a reminder, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju tɛkst mi ə rɪˈmaɪndər pliːz?/
dialogue.zh: 可以寄簡訊提醒我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We send one message the day before.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi sɛnd wʌn ˈmɛsɪdʒ ðə deɪ bɪˈfɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我們會在前一天寄一則訊息給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the parking lot near the side door?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈpɑrkɪŋ lɑt nɪr ðə saɪd dɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 停車場在側門附近嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Park by the garden gate, it's closer.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɑrk baɪ ðə ˈgɑrdən geɪt ɪts ˈkloʊsər./
dialogue.zh: 停在花園小門那邊，比較近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I come early to change first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kʌm ˈɜrli tə tʃeɪndʒ fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 我該早一點來換衣服嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes early is perfect for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ˈɜrli ɪz ˈpɜrfɪkt fɔr ju./
dialogue.zh: 早十分鐘到最剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time do you close on Sunday?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt taɪm du ju kloʊs ɑn ˈsʌndeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 週日你們幾點打烊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine at night, so be back by eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn æt naɪt soʊ bi bæk baɪ eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 晚上九點關門，所以八點前要回到大廳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a shelf for my bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ʃɛlf fɔr maɪ bæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 有沒有地方可以放我的包？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your locker holds the bag and your coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈlɑkər hoʊldz ðə bæɡ ænd jɔr koʊt./
dialogue.zh: 你的櫃子放得下包和外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I wear my own swimsuit inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ wɛr maɪ oʊn ˈswɪmˌsut ɪnˈsaɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 裡面可以穿自己的泳裝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swimsuits are needed in the plunge pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈswɪmˌsuts ɑr ˈnidəd ɪn ðə plʌndʒ pul./
dialogue.zh: 進冷水池一定要穿泳裝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do men use the same changing room?
dialogue.phonetic: /du mɛn juz ðə seɪm ˈtʃeɪndʒɪŋ rum?/
dialogue.zh: 男賓女賓共用同一間更衣室嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, men go down, women go up.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ mɛn goʊ daʊn ˈwɪmɪn goʊ ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 不會，男賓在一樓，女賓在樓上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I bring a book along?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ brɪŋ ə bʊk əˈlɔŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以帶一本書來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Books wait in the lounge, never in the sauna.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʊks weɪt ɪn ðə laʊndʒ ˈnɛvər ɪn ðə ˈsaʊnə./
dialogue.zh: 書可以擱在喝茶區，就是別帶進桑拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are phones allowed in the tea lounge?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr foʊnz əˈlaʊd ɪn ðə ti laʊndʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 喝茶區可以用手機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Phones stay off after the locker room.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊnz steɪ ɔf ˈæftər ðə ˈlɑkər rum./
dialogue.zh: 手機過了寄物櫃那一區就要關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have one more question about hair.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv wʌn mɔr ˈkwɛstʃən əˈbaʊt hɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我還有一個關於頭髮的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tie it up before the steam room, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪ ɪt ʌp bɪˈfɔr ðə stim rum pliːz./
dialogue.zh: 進蒸氣室之前請先把頭髮綁起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the ninety minutes include a face massage?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈnaɪnti ˈmɪnɪts ɪnˈklud ə feɪs ˈməsɑʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 九十分鐘裡包含臉部按摩嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, twenty quiet minutes on the warm bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈtwɛnti ˈkwaɪət ˈmɪnɪts ɑn ðə wɔrm bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 有，在溫熱的床上安靜地做二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my friend sit in the tea lounge?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn maɪ frɛnd sɪt ɪn ðə ti laʊndʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 我的朋友可以坐在喝茶區等我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her pass costs ten dollars more, that's all.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr pæs kɔsts tɛn ˈdɑlərz mɔr ðæts ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 她的入場券只要多花十元，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are kids allowed out on the garden deck?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr kɪdz əˈlaʊd aʊt ɑn ðə ˈgɑrdən dɛk?/
dialogue.zh: 小朋友可以到庭院的平台上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only past twelve years, I'm sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli pæst twɛlv jɪrz aɪm ˈsɑri./
dialogue.zh: 要滿十二歲才行，真不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cold plunge scares me a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə koʊld plʌndʒ skɛrz mi ə ˈlɪtəl./
dialogue.zh: 冷水浸泡其實讓我有點害怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We begin with cool water on your feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi bɪˈgɪn wɪθ kul ˈwɔtər ɑn jɔr fit./
dialogue.zh: 我們會先從沖腳的涼水開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you pour oil on the sauna stones?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju pɔr ɔɪl ɑn ðə ˈsaʊnə stoʊnz?/
dialogue.zh: 桑拿的石頭上會倒精油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never oil there, only clean water, all right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər ɔɪl ðɛr ˈoʊnli klin ˈwɔtər ɔl raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 那邊絕不用油，只倒清水，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use my own lavender oil?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ juz maɪ oʊn ˈlævəndər ɔɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 我能用自己的薰衣草精油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring it, we'll warm it for your face.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ɪt wil wɔrm ɪt fɔr jɔr feɪs./
dialogue.zh: 帶來吧，我們會為你的臉把它溫熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the face massage strong or gentle here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə feɪs ˈməsɑʒ strɔŋ ɔr ˈdʒɛntəl hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的臉部按摩是用力還是溫柔？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The therapist asks twice, you just answer her.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈθɛrəpɪst æskz twaɪs ju dʒʌst ˈænsər hɜr./
dialogue.zh: 按摩師會問兩次，你只要回答她。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will someone stay with me that first time?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ˈsʌmwʌn steɪ wɪθ mi ðæt fɜrst taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 第一次浸泡時會有人陪著我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A guide stands right at the pool edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə gaɪd stændz raɪt æt ðə pul ɛdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 會有人就站在池邊看著你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How hot is the sauna, in numbers?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ hɑt ɪz ðə ˈsaʊnə ɪn ˈnʌmbərz?/
dialogue.zh: 桑拿大約是幾度？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eighty five, the wall shows it for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈeɪti faɪv ðə wɔl ʃoʊz ɪt fɔr ju./
dialogue.zh: 八十五度，牆上有數字讓你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which bench should I take, up or down?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ bɛntʃ ʃʊd aɪ teɪk ʌp ɔr daʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 我該坐上排還是下排？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start low; the top bench is too hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt loʊ ðə tɑp bɛntʃ ɪz tu hɑt./
dialogue.zh: 先坐低處，上排對新來的太熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I shower before the sauna, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ˈʃaʊər bɪˈfɔr ðə ˈsaʊnə ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 那進桑拿之前要先沖澡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A quick rinse, two minutes is plenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kwɪk rɪns tu ˈmɪnɪts ɪz ˈplɛnti./
dialogue.zh: 簡單沖一下，兩分鐘就夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I just rest and do nothing here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ dʒʌst rɛst ænd du ˈnʌθɪŋ hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以什麼都不做，就躺著休息嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That truly is the plan, nothing else.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈtruːli ɪz ðə plæn ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls./
dialogue.zh: 那正是這裡的安排，別的都不用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So my ninety minutes starts at four thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪ ˈnaɪnti ˈmɪnɪts stɑrts æt fɔr ˈθɜrdi./
dialogue.zh: 所以我的九十分鐘從四點半開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, four thirty; what's your locker code?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs fɔr ˈθɜrdi wʌts jɔr ˈlɑkər koʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 對，四點半；請問您的寄物櫃密碼是？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine is nine oh five, two one, seven four.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ɪz naɪn oʊ faɪv tu wʌn ˈsɛvən fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我的密碼是九零五、二一、七四。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, nine oh five two, all done.
dialogue.phonetic: /gɑt ɪt naɪn oʊ faɪv tu ɔl dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 記下了，九零五二，全都錄好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you read that number back to me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju rid ðæt ˈnʌmbər bæk tə mi?/
dialogue.zh: 可以把我那組號碼唸回來給我聽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine, oh, five, two, one, seven, four.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn oʊ faɪv tu wʌn ˈsɛvən fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 九、零、五、二、一、七、四。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's mine, exactly the right seven digits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts maɪn ɪɡˈzæktli ðə raɪt ˈsɛvən ˈdɪdʒɪts./
dialogue.zh: 就是我那組，七位數完全正確。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now your name, Lin, is safe with us.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ jɔr neɪm lɪn ɪz seɪf wɪθ ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 那你的名字林，我們就記好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have soap inside the showers?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv soʊp ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈʃaʊərz?/
dialogue.zh: 淋浴間裡有肥皂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cedar soap, gentle on freshly steamed skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsidər soʊp ˈdʒɛntəl ɑn ˈfrɛʃli stimd skɪn./
dialogue.zh: 有雪松皂，剛蒸過的皮膚用著很溫和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the cedar soap for, exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðə ˈsidər soʊp fɔr ɪɡˈzæktli?/
dialogue.zh: 雪松皂具體是用來做什麼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It smells like the whole sauna room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt smɛlz laɪk ðə hoʊl ˈsaʊnə rum./
dialogue.zh: 它的味道聞起來就像整間桑拿房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a place to sit while I dry?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə pleɪs tə sɪt waɪl aɪ draɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 擦身體的時候有地方可以坐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A warm bench waits by the cold pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɔrm bɛntʃ weɪts baɪ ðə koʊld pul./
dialogue.zh: 冷水池邊有一張溫熱的長椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last thing, may I ask your name?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst θɪŋ meɪ aɪ æsk jɔr neɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 最後一件事，請問你怎麼稱呼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm Ivy, I'll be here at four thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈaɪvi aɪl bi hɪr æt fɔr ˈθɜrdi./
dialogue.zh: 我叫艾薇，四點半我會在這兒值班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, Ivy, I feel calmer now.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ˈaɪvi aɪ fil ˈkɑmər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你艾薇，我現在安心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most first timers feel just like you.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst fɜrst ˈtaɪmərz fil dʒʌst laɪk ju./
dialogue.zh: 大部分第一次來的人都跟你一樣緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you Sunday at the garden gate then.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ˈsʌndeɪ æt ðə ˈgɑrdən geɪt ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那我們週日花園小門見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the blue door, under the tall pines.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðə blu dɔr ˈʌndər ðə tɔl paɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 就那扇藍色門，在高高的松樹下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll bring my lavender oil, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl brɪŋ maɪ ˈlævəndər ɔɪl tu./
dialogue.zh: 我也會把我的薰衣草精油帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring it, and I'll warm it by five.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ɪt ænd aɪl wɔrm ɪt baɪ faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 帶來吧，五點前我會先把它溫好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunday, four thirty, one ninety minute pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌndeɪ fɔr ˈθɜrdi wʌn ˈnaɪnti ˈmɪnɪt pæs./
dialogue.zh: 週日四點半，一張九十分鐘的券。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Booked, and welcome to Pine Ridge Spa.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʊkt ænd ˈwɛlkəm tə paɪn rɪdʒ spɑ./
dialogue.zh: 訂好了，歡迎來到松嶺水療。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That phone call was easier than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt foʊn kɔl wʌz ˈizɪər ðæn aɪ θɔt./
dialogue.zh: 這通電話比我想像中簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hard part is the cold pool, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hɑrd pɑrt ɪz ðə koʊld pul ðoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 不過真正難的還是那個冷水池。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I only have to find that gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ ˈoʊnli hæv tə faɪnd ðæt geɪt./
dialogue.zh: 現在我得先去找到那扇小門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's the blue door, with one stone step.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ðə blu dɔr wɪð wʌn stoʊn stɛp./
dialogue.zh: 就是那扇藍門，前面有一階石階。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm Lin, I booked for four thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm lɪn aɪ bʊkt fɔr fɔr ˈθɜrdi./
dialogue.zh: 你好，我是林，預約了四點半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome in, here is your wrist band.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm ɪn hɪr ɪz jɔr rɪst bænd./
dialogue.zh: 歡迎進來，這是你的手腕帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I wear this all through the visit?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ wɛr ðɪs ɔl θru ðə ˈvɪzɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 這個我要全程一路戴著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it opens every door but the office.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt ˈoʊpənz ˈɛvəri dɔr bʌt ðə ˈɔfɪs./
dialogue.zh: 對，除了辦公室，它每一扇門都開得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which rooms does my pass include?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ rumz dʌz maɪ pæs ɪnˈklud?/
dialogue.zh: 我的券包含哪幾間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four areas: sauna, steam, plunge, tea lounge.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈɛriəz ˈsaʊnə stim plʌndʒ ti laʊndʒ./
dialogue.zh: 四個區：桑拿、蒸氣室、冷水池、喝茶區。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the dry heat room, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðə draɪ hit rum ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 那間乾熱的房間是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the sauna, wood walls, no water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈsaʊnə wʊd wɔlz noʊ ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 那是桑拿，木頭牆，沒有水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the steam room has wet air?
dialogue.phonetic: /æn ðə stim rum hæz wɛt ɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 蒸氣室裡的空氣是濕的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wet heat, it softens the face first.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛt hit ɪt ˈsɔfənz ðə feɪs fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 濕的熱氣，會讓臉先軟下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where exactly is the cold plunge pool?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪɡˈzæktli ɪz ðə koʊld plʌndʒ pul?/
dialogue.zh: 冷水池確實是在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Past the steam, under the small glass roof.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæst ðə stim ˈʌndər ðə smɔl glæs ruf./
dialogue.zh: 過了蒸氣室，在小玻璃屋頂下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the tea lounge on this floor too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ti laʊndʒ ɑn ðɪs flɔr tu?/
dialogue.zh: 喝茶區也在這一樓嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, up six stairs, beside the quiet deck.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ʌp sɪks stɛrz bəˈsaɪd ðə ˈkwaɪət dɛk./
dialogue.zh: 不是，往上六階，就在安靜平台旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does my pass cover the face room today?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz maɪ pæs ˈkʌvər ðə feɪs rum təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 我今天的券包含臉部按摩間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does, at five twenty, room number four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz æt faɪv ˈtwɛnti rum ˈnʌmbər fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 有，五點二十，四號房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a warm pool to sit in?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə wɔrm pul tə sɪt ɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 有沒有可以泡著坐著的溫水池？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The foot bath stays full all afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fʊt bæθ steɪz fʊl ɔl ˌæftərˈnun./
dialogue.zh: 燙腳的池子整個下午都是滿的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I stay on the deck a while?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ steɪ ɑn ðə dɛk ə waɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在平台上待一會兒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The deck is yours until the last round.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɛk ɪz jɔrz ʌnˈtɪl ðə læst raʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 平台屬於你，直到最後一回熱身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I do first, sauna or steam?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ʃʊd aɪ du fɜrst ˈsaʊnə ɔr stim?/
dialogue.zh: 我該先做哪一個，桑拿還是蒸氣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Steam opens you; the sauna finishes the job.
dialogue.phonetic: /stim ˈoʊpənz ju ðə ˈsaʊnə ˈfɪnɪʃɪz ðə dʒɑb./
dialogue.zh: 蒸氣先把身體打開，桑拿做完剩下的一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many rounds of heat do people take?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni raʊndz ʌv hit du ˈpipəl teɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 大家通常熱身幾回？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three rounds feels right for a first day.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri raʊndz filz raɪt fɔr ə fɜrst deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 第一天的話，三回剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a guide, or go alone?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ə gaɪd ɔr goʊ əˈloʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 我需要有人帶，還是自己走？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Alone is fine, I'll show you the map.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈloʊn ɪz faɪn aɪl ʃoʊ ju ðə mæp./
dialogue.zh: 自己走沒問題，我先把地圖指給你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I leave my shoes, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ liv maɪ ʃuz ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 那我的鞋子要放在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cubby by the cedar bench, bottom row.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʌbi baɪ ðə ˈsidər bɛntʃ ˈbɑtəm roʊ./
dialogue.zh: 雪松長椅邊的小格位，最下一排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the robes warm when you hand them?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə roʊbz wɔrm wɛn ju hænd ðɛm?/
dialogue.zh: 你們遞過來的袍子是暖的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh from the dryer, folded by size.
dialogue.phonetic: /frɛʃ frʌm ðə ˈdraɪər ˈfoʊldəd baɪ saɪz./
dialogue.zh: 才從烘乾機取出，依尺寸摺好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which size robe should I pick?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ saɪz roʊb ʃʊd aɪ pɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 袍子我該挑哪個尺寸？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Medium fits most, the tags hang right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmidɪəm fɪts moʊst ðə tæɡz hæŋ raɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 中號最多人合身，吊牌就掛在這。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is locker number twenty seven?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ˈlɑkər ˈnʌmbər ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən?/
dialogue.zh: 二十七號的寄物櫃在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second hallway, left side, by the tall mirror.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd ˈhɔlweɪ lɛft saɪd baɪ ðə tɔl ˈmɪrər./
dialogue.zh: 第二條走道左邊，高大鏡子旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the areas have signs I can follow?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ði ˈɛriəz hæv saɪnz aɪ kæn ˈfɑloʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 各區有我可以跟著走的牌子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small wooden boards, one at every doorway.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ˈwʊdən bɔrdz wʌn æt ˈɛvəri ˈdɔrˌweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 小木牌，每個門口都掛一面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I refill my water somewhere inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ riˈfɪl maɪ ˈwɔtər ˈsʌmwɛr ɪnˈsaɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在裡面哪個地方幫自己倒水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The jug sits next to the tea counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒʌɡ sɪts nɛkst tə ðə ti ˈkaʊntər./
dialogue.zh: 壺就擺在茶的櫃台旁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the whole place phone free?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə hoʊl pleɪs foʊn fri?/
dialogue.zh: 整個地方都是不碰手機的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the locker room keeps a signal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə ˈlɑkər rum kips ə ˈsɪgnəl./
dialogue.zh: 只有寄物櫃那區還有訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I wear perfume into the heat rooms?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ wɛr ˈpɜrfjum ˈɪntu ðə hit rumz?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以擦香水進那些熱房嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please skip it; the steam holds every scent.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliːz skɪp ɪt ðə stim hoʊldz ˈɛvəri sɛnt./
dialogue.zh: 請別擦；蒸氣會把任何味道都留住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have to be quiet in the sauna?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ hæv tə bi ˈkwaɪət ɪn ðə ˈsaʊnə?/
dialogue.zh: 我在桑拿裡一定得安靜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Whispers only, most people close their eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪspərz ˈoʊnli moʊst ˈpipəl kloʊz ðɛr aɪz./
dialogue.zh: 只能小小聲，多數人都閉著眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time should I be back at the desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt taɪm ʃʊd aɪ bi bæk æt ðə dɛsk?/
dialogue.zh: 我幾點要回到櫃台？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five twenty for the face room, that's the clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈtwɛnti fɔr ðə feɪs rum ðæts ðə klɑk./
dialogue.zh: 五點二十進臉部按摩間，時間就是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there any rooms I should skip today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðɛr ˈɛni rumz aɪ ʃʊd skɪp təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 今天有沒有哪間我得先避開？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The clay room is closed for washing today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kleɪ rum ɪz kloʊzd fɔr ˈwɑʃɪŋ təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 泥膜那間今天暫停，他們在清洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which part do guests fear the most?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ pɑrt du ɡɛsts fɪr ðə moʊst?/
dialogue.zh: 客人最怕的是哪一段？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The plunge, and then they love it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə plʌndʒ ænd ðɛn ðeɪ lʌv ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 就是那池冷水，可是接著愛上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to ask before pouring water?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə æsk bɪˈfɔr ˈpɔrɪŋ ˈwɔtər?/
dialogue.zh: 潑水之前我得先問一聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always ask the room, then pour one ladle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlˌweɪz æsk ðə rum ðɛn pɔr wʌn ˈlædəl./
dialogue.zh: 一定要先問房裡的人，再舀一瓢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is a ladle, exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ə ˈlædəl ɪɡˈzæktli?/
dialogue.zh: 你說的那個水瓢是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small wooden cup on a long handle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl ˈwʊdən kʌp ɑn ə lɔŋ ˈhændəl./
dialogue.zh: 一個長柄的小木杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do people really sit there for five minutes?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈpipəl ˈrɪli sɪt ðɛr fɔr faɪv ˈmɪnɪts?/
dialogue.zh: 真的有人在裡頭坐滿五分鐘嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five, then cool feet, then five again.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ðɛn kul fit ðɛn faɪv əˈgɛn./
dialogue.zh: 五分鐘，然後涼腳，再五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the tea lounge open the whole time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ti laʊndʒ ˈoʊpən ðə hoʊl taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 喝茶區整段時間都開著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stays warm from noon until nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt steɪz wɔrm frʌm nun ʌnˈtɪl naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 從中午到九點都是暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What kinds of tea do you pour there?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt kaɪndz ʌv ti du ju pɔr ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 那邊會倒哪幾種茶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ginger, chamomile, and a plain roasted grain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒɪndʒər kæˈmɑmɪl ænd ə pleɪn ˈroʊstɪd greɪn./
dialogue.zh: 薑茶、洋甘菊茶，還有一款炒米茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the ginger tea very strong?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈdʒɪndʒər ti ˈvɛri strɔŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 薑茶會不會很辣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It warms the belly after the cold water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɔrmz ðə ˈbɛli ˈæftər ðə koʊld ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 泡完冷水後，它會讓肚子暖起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I sit in the lounge without a robe?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ sɪt ɪn ðə laʊndʒ wɪˈðaʊt ə roʊb?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以不穿袍子坐在喝茶區嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Robe on, shoulders covered, that's the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊb ɑn ˈʃoʊldərz ˈkʌvərd ðæts ðə rul./
dialogue.zh: 袍子要穿、肩要蓋住，這是規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there chairs that lie all the way back?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðɛr tʃɛrz ðæt laɪ ɔl ðə weɪ bæk?/
dialogue.zh: 有能完全躺下來的椅子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six recliners face the small window.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks rɪˈklaɪnərz feɪs ðə smɔl ˈwɪndoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 六張躺椅都面向那扇小窗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that window looking at the pines?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ˈwɪndoʊ ˈlʊkɪŋ æt ðə paɪnz?/
dialogue.zh: 那扇窗看出去是松樹嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pines, and one very slow river.
dialogue.phonetic: /paɪnz ænd wʌn ˈvɛri sloʊ ˈrɪvər./
dialogue.zh: 是松樹，還有一條很慢的河。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have to join any group class?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ hæv tə dʒɔɪn ˈɛni grup klæs?/
dialogue.zh: 我一定要參加集體課程嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing required; a breath class starts at six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ rɪˈkwaɪərd ə brɛθ klæs stɑrts æt sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 一點都不強制；六點有一節呼吸課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I skip the breath class, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ skɪp ðə brɛθ klæs ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 那我可以跳過呼吸課嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, this hour belongs to you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs ðɪs ˈaʊər bɪˈlɔŋz tə ju./
dialogue.zh: 當然，這一個小時由你決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happens at the end of ninety minutes?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈhæpənz æt ði ɛnd ʌv ˈnaɪnti ˈmɪnɪts?/
dialogue.zh: 九十分鐘結束時會怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ivy comes and asks how you feel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaɪvi kʌmz ænd æskz haʊ ju fil./
dialogue.zh: 艾薇會過來，問你感覺如何。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a place to buy tea to go?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə pleɪs tə baɪ ti tə goʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 有沒有地方可以買茶帶走？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shelf by the till has small bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɛlf baɪ ðə tɪl hæz smɔl bæɡz./
dialogue.zh: 收銀台旁的架上擺著小茶包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell the cedar soap as well?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju sɛl ðə ˈsidər soʊp æz wɛl?/
dialogue.zh: 雪松皂也賣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two bars sit wrapped beside the cash drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu bɑrz sɪt ræpt bəˈsaɪd ðə kæʃ drɔr./
dialogue.zh: 有兩條包好的，放在抽屜旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which area do most guests like best?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈɛriə du moʊst ɡɛsts laɪk bɛst?/
dialogue.zh: 多數客人最喜歡哪一個區？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The warm bench after the second plunge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɔrm bɛntʃ ˈæftər ðə ˈsɛkənd plʌndʒ./
dialogue.zh: 第二次泡完冷水後那張暖椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the sauna room ever too full?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈsaʊnə rum ˈɛvər tu fʊl?/
dialogue.zh: 桑拿會不會有時擠到不行？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At six it fills, come in at five.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt sɪks ɪt fɪlz kʌm ɪn æt faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 六點最滿，五點進去了得剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I bring my robe up to the lounge?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ brɪŋ maɪ roʊb ʌp tə ðə laʊndʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把袍子一並穿到樓上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but not past the tea counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt nɑt pæst ðə ti ˈkaʊntər./
dialogue.zh: 可以，但不能穿過倒茶那張台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the slippers allowed on the deck?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə ˈslɪpərz əˈlaʊd ɑn ðə dɛk?/
dialogue.zh: 拖鞋可以穿到平台上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deck shoes wait just outside the glass door.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɛk ʃuz weɪt dʒʌst ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðə glæs dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 平台用的鞋就放在玻璃門外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I find room number four later?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ faɪnd rum ˈnʌmbər fɔr ˈleɪtər?/
dialogue.zh: 待會兒我怎麼找四號房？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Down the green hall, past the warm towels.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn ðə grin hɔl pæst ðə wɔrm ˈtaʊəlz./
dialogue.zh: 沿綠色走廊走，經過熱毛巾那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I tell them about my sore shoulder?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tɛl ðɛm əˈbaʊt maɪ sɔr ˈʃoʊldər?/
dialogue.zh: 我該不該跟他們說我肩胛痠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the face therapist works on necks too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə feɪs ˈθɛrəpɪst wɜrks ɑn nɛks tu./
dialogue.zh: 該說，做臉那位也幫頸部鬆開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is everything included, or do I pay later?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɪnˈkluːdɪd ɔr du aɪ peɪ ˈleɪtər?/
dialogue.zh: 全部都有了，還是有什麼要另外付？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everything but the extra oil, that's ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriθɪŋ bʌt ðə ˈɛkstrə ɔɪl ðæts tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 就是加精油要另收十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think I'm ready, show me the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk aɪm ˈrɛdi ʃoʊ mi ðə hɔl./
dialogue.zh: 我覺得我準備好了，帶我進走道吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This way, and keep your band visible.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs weɪ ænd kip jɔr bænd ˈvɪzəbəl./
dialogue.zh: 這邊走，手腕帶要露在外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The air already smells like hot wood.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɛr ɔlˈrɛdi smɛlz laɪk hɑt wʊd./
dialogue.zh: 空氣裡已經有木頭被烤過的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the sauna breathing at the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈsaʊnə ˈbriðɪŋ æt ði ɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 那是桑拿在最裡頭呼著熱氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can hear water dripping somewhere near.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kən hɪr ˈwɔtər ˈdrɪpɪŋ ˈsʌmwɛr nɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我聽到附近有水在一滴一滴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Steam room, left door, take your time.
dialogue.phonetic: /stim rum lɛft dɔr teɪk jɔr taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 蒸氣室，左邊那扇門，慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, areas first, then my robe and locker.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈɛriəz fɜrst ðɛn maɪ roʊb ænd ˈlɑkər./
dialogue.zh: 好，先認各區，再去拿袍子和櫃子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Locker twenty seven is waiting, right this way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɑkər ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən ɪz ˈweɪtɪŋ raɪt ðɪs weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 二十七號櫃子正等你，就這邊走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is locker twenty seven this small door?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈlɑkər ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən ðɪs smɔl dɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 二十七號櫃就是這扇小門嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap your band here and it opens.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp jɔr bænd hɪr ænd ɪt ˈoʊpənz./
dialogue.zh: 把手環貼上來，櫃門就開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a hook, a shelf, one basket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ə hʊk ə ʃɛlf wʌn ˈbæskɪt./
dialogue.zh: 這裡有掛鉤、一個小層架、一個籃子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The basket holds the things you touch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbæskɪt hoʊldz ðə θɪŋz ju tʌtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 籃子放你會一直摸的那些東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should my coat hang or fold here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd maɪ koʊt hæŋ ɔr foʊld hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我的外套是要掛起來還是摺起來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hang the coat, the hook is strong.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæŋ ðə koʊt ðə hʊk ɪz strɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 掛起來就好，那個鉤子很結實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wet wool, my jacket smells like the rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛt wʊl maɪ ˈdʒækɪt smɛlz laɪk ðə reɪn./
dialogue.zh: 濕過的羊毛料，我的外套聞起來有雨水味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shelf has air, it will dry by nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɛlf hæz ɛr ɪt wɪl draɪ baɪ naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 架上通風，九點以前會乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is my robe, medium, on the rail.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz maɪ roʊb ˈmidɪəm ɑn ðə reɪl./
dialogue.zh: 我的袍子在這裡，中號，掛在桿上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tie the belt once, then twice more.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪ ðə bɛlt wʌns ðɛn twaɪs mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 腰帶先繫一圈，再繫兩圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This rope belt is longer than me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs roʊp bɛlt ɪz ˈlɔŋɡər ðæn mi./
dialogue.zh: 這條腰帶比我的腰還長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loop it high, the knot slides down.
dialogue.phonetic: /lup ɪt haɪ ðə nɑt slaɪdz daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 往上繞一圈，結自己會滑下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the pockets meant for anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə ˈpɑkɪts mɛnt fɔr ˈɛniθɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 袍子的口袋是有用的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They hold the band and one small comb.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ hoʊld ðə bænd ænd wʌn smɔl koʊm./
dialogue.zh: 能放手環和一把小梳子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two slippers, left and right, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈslɪpərz lɛft ænd raɪt aɪ θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 兩隻拖鞋還分左右嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both are the same, the floor is wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ɑr ðə seɪm ðə flɔr ɪz wɛt./
dialogue.zh: 兩隻一模一樣，地板本來就是濕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I wear the swimsuit under the robe?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ wɛr ðə ˈswɪmˌsut ˈʌndər ðə roʊb?/
dialogue.zh: 泳裝要穿在袍子裡面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the plunge counts swimsuit as clothes.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə plʌndʒ kaʊnts ˈswɪmˌsut æz kloʊz./
dialogue.zh: 要，冷水池把泳裝當作衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These street clothes, where do they go?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz strit kloʊz wɛr du ðeɪ goʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 那這身出門的衣服，要收在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Into the basket, under the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɪntu ðə ˈbæskɪt ˈʌndər ðə ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 放進籃子，壓在層架下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I shut my phone or silence it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ʃʌt maɪ foʊn ɔr ˈsaɪləns ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 手機是要關掉還是靜音？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shut it, the walls carry every ring.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʌt ɪt ðə wɔlz ˈkæri ˈɛvəri rɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 關掉吧，牆會把每一聲鈴傳很遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This watch has a metal clasp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wɑtʃ hæz ə ˈmɛtəl klæsp./
dialogue.zh: 這支表用的是金屬扣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lay it flat in the small tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /leɪ ɪt flæt ɪn ðə smɔl treɪ./
dialogue.zh: 平平放在那個小淺盤裡就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I put my two earrings?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ pʊt maɪ tu ˈɪrˌrɪŋz?/
dialogue.zh: 我的兩個耳環要放哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The little dish by the mirror, left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɪtəl dɪʃ baɪ ðə ˈmɪrər lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 鏡子邊的小碟，左邊那一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need my glasses to read the signs.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid maɪ ˈglæsɪz tə rid ðə saɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 我需要戴眼鏡才看得清牌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep them with you, the print is small.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðɛm wɪθ ju ðə prɪnt ɪz smɔl./
dialogue.zh: 帶著走吧，字印得很小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a hair tie inside the room?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə hɛr taɪ ɪnˈsaɪd ðə rum?/
dialogue.zh: 房間裡有綁頭髮的繩子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A soft band hangs on the second hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə sɔft bænd hæŋz ɑn ðə ˈsɛkənd hʊk./
dialogue.zh: 第二個鉤子上掛著一條軟的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I take the cotton head band?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ teɪk ðə ˈkɑtən hɛd bænd?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以拿那條棉的束髮帶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps hair off your face in the heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kips hɛr ɔf jɔr feɪs ɪn ðə hit./
dialogue.zh: 它讓頭髮在熱房裡碰不到臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two towels here, one big, one small.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈtaʊəlz hɪr wʌn bɪɡ wʌn smɔl./
dialogue.zh: 這裡有兩條毛巾，一大的、一小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The big one goes under you in the sauna.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪɡ wʌn goʊz ˈʌndər ju ɪn ðə ˈsaʊnə./
dialogue.zh: 大的那條在桑拿裡墊著坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the small towel for, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðə smɔl ˈtaʊəl fɔr ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 那條小的是用來做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It dabs the face, never the wood bench.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dæbz ðə feɪs ˈnɛvər ðə wʊd bɛntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 只壓臉，絕對不去擦木椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the robe allowed up in the lounge?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə roʊb əˈlaʊd ʌp ɪn ðə laʊndʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 袍子可以穿到樓上的喝茶區嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It goes with you, everywhere but the street.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt goʊz wɪð ju ˈɛvriˌwɛr bʌt ðə strit./
dialogue.zh: 它跟著你去任何地方，就是別穿到街上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mirror light is very soft here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɪrər laɪt ɪz ˈvɛri sɔft hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的鏡前燈好柔和。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Low light, so eyes rest before the heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ laɪt soʊ aɪz rɛst bɪˈfɔr ðə hit./
dialogue.zh: 光是刻意壓暗的，讓眼睛先休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are hair dryers allowed in this room?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr hɛr ˈdraɪərz əˈlaʊd ɪn ðɪs rum?/
dialogue.zh: 這一間裡可以用吹風機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None in here, the tea lounge keeps two.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌn ɪn hɪr ðə ti laʊndʒ kips tu./
dialogue.zh: 這裡一台也沒有，喝茶區留了兩台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the rinse shower, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə rɪns ˈʃaʊər pliːz?/
dialogue.zh: 請問沖水的淋浴間在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Past the robes, the door with the blue line.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæst ðə roʊbz ðə dɔr wɪð ðə blu laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 過了袍子那邊，那扇畫藍線的門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which knob gives the hot water?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ nɑb ɡivz ðə hɑt ˈwɔtər?/
dialogue.zh: 哪一顆旋鈕會出熱水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn left slowly, it comes fast here.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn lɛft ˈsloʊli ɪt kʌmz fæst hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢往左轉，這裡熱水來得特別快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold tile, it bites my feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld taɪl ɪt baɪts maɪ fit./
dialogue.zh: 地磚冰涼，冰得腳底發疼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wear the slippers, even to the shower.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ðə ˈslɪpərz ˈivɪn tə ðə ˈʃaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 拖鞋要穿，連走到淋浴間那幾步也穿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I use soap, or only water?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ juz soʊp ɔr ˈoʊnli ˈwɔtər?/
dialogue.zh: 我該用肥皂，還是只用清水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only water now; soap comes after the heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ˈwɔtər naʊ soʊp kʌmz ˈæftər ðə hit./
dialogue.zh: 現在只用清水，肥皂留到熱完以後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my hair get wet in the rinse?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl maɪ hɛr ɡɛt wɛt ɪn ðə rɪns?/
dialogue.zh: 沖水的時候頭髮會濕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little; the cap keeps it dry enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl ðə kæp kips ɪt draɪ ɪˈnʌf./
dialogue.zh: 會濕一點；毛帽能讓它夠乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cap for the head, really?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kæp fɔr ðə hɛd ˈrɪli?/
dialogue.zh: 頭上還要戴一頂帽子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps the top bench kind to you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kips ðə tɑp bɛntʃ kaɪnd tə ju./
dialogue.zh: 它讓上排座位對你溫和許多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, my band just beeped.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn maɪ bænd dʒʌst bipt./
dialogue.zh: 等一下，我的手環剛剛嗶了一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means the sauna side is open now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ðə ˈsaʊnə saɪd ɪz ˈoʊpən naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那代表桑拿那一側現在開放了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm towels live in that wooden box?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ˈtaʊəlz lɪv ɪn ðæt ˈwʊdən bɑks?/
dialogue.zh: 熱毛巾放在那個木箱裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, open it, the heat stays for ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈoʊpən ɪt ðə hit steɪz fɔr tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 對，打開它，暖度會留十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, this ring is old, don't want it lost.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðɪs rɪŋ ɪz oʊld doʊnt wɑnt ɪt lɔst./
dialogue.zh: 喔，這枚戒指很舊，我不想把它弄丟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The desk safe keeps it till you leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɛsk seɪf kips ɪt tɪl ju liv./
dialogue.zh: 櫃台的保險櫃會替你保管到你離開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Long hair, a problem in the heat?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ hɛr ə ˈprɑbləm ɪn ðə hit?/
dialogue.zh: 頭髮這麼長，在熱氣裡會不會礙事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tie it loose, tight knots leave a mark.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪ ɪt lus taɪt nɑts liv ə mɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 綁鬆一點，綁太緊會在額頭留痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The steam will curl my hair more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stim wil kɜrl maɪ hɛr mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 蒸氣會讓我的頭髮更捲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's normal, the oil fixes it later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈnɔrməl ðə ɔɪl ˈfɪksɪz ɪt ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 那很尋常，之後抹點油就順了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This robe is wider than my shoulders.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs roʊb ɪz ˈwaɪdər ðæn maɪ ˈʃoʊldərz./
dialogue.zh: 這件袍子比我的肩寬了太多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull the belt once, the room shrinks.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ðə bɛlt wʌns ðə rum ʃrɪŋks./
dialogue.zh: 腰帶用力拉一圈，袍子就服貼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sleeves fall down on my hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə slivz fɔl daʊn ɑn maɪ hændz./
dialogue.zh: 袖子一直垂到我的手背上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roll them twice, everyone does that.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊl ðɛm twaɪs ˈɛvriˌwʌn dʌz ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 捲兩道就好，每個人都這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, this locker door won't shut all the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ðɪs ˈlɑkər dɔr woʊnt ʃʌt ɔl ðə weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 你看，這個櫃門關不到最底。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push the band once more, then it clicks.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ðə bænd wʌns mɔr ðɛn ɪt klɪks./
dialogue.zh: 手環再壓一次，就會喀一聲鎖上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The basket fits back in, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbæskɪt fɪts bæk ɪn raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 籃子能壓平再收回去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, handle down, the door shuts clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈhændəl daʊn ðə dɔr ʃʌts klin./
dialogue.zh: 可以，提把朝下，門就關得整齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I left my bag straps outside the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lɛft maɪ bæɡ stræps ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我的包帶子還露在門外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hang it on the low hook, it's fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæŋ ɪt ɑn ðə loʊ hʊk ɪts faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 掛到低的那個鉤子上，沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do wet towels go when I'm done?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du wɛt ˈtaʊəlz goʊ wɛn aɪm dʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 用過的濕毛巾後來要放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The woven hamper, by the steam door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwoʊvən ˈhæmpər baɪ ðə stim dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 蒸氣門旁那個編織的大簍子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I return the robe at the end?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ rɪˈtɜrn ðə roʊb æt ði ɛnd?/
dialogue.zh: 行程結束時袍子要歸還嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it folded on the cedar bench.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt ˈfoʊldəd ɑn ðə ˈsidər bɛntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 摺好放在雪松椅上就可以了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One sock got wet near the plunge.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn sɑk gɑt wɛt nɪr ðə plʌndʒ./
dialogue.zh: 我有一隻襪子在冷水池邊濕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The drawer by the shower has dry pairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə drɔər baɪ ðə ˈʃaʊər hæz draɪ pɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 淋浴邊那個抽屜裡有成雙乾襪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I carry a second face towel?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ ˈkæri ə ˈsɛkənd feɪs ˈtaʊəl?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以再拿第二條擦臉的毛巾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take two, the tea lounge needs one.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk tu ðə ti laʊndʒ nidz wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 拿兩條吧，喝茶區也會用掉一條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The light here hums very quietly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪt hɪr hʌmz ˈvɛri ˈkwaɪətli./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的燈會輕輕作響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's the lamp, the whole floor does that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ðə læmp ðə hoʊl flɔr dʌz ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 是燈管，這一整層都會那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I smell soap, cedar, and something warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ smɛl soʊp ˈsidər ænd ˈsʌmθɪŋ wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 我聞到肥皂、雪松，還有暖暖的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the steam door standing open.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə stim dɔr ˈstændɪŋ ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 那是蒸氣室的門沒關上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, my band says four thirty five.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk maɪ bænd sɛz fɔr ˈθɜrdi faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 你看，我的手環上寫著四點三十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five minutes to start, take the steps.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈmɪnɪts tə stɑrt teɪk ðə stɛps./
dialogue.zh: 還有五分鐘可以開始，往前那幾步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steps, or a ramp along the wall?
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛps ɔr ə ræmp əˈlɔŋ ðə wɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 要爬階梯，還是沿牆有坡道？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ramp is easier with wet feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ræmp ɪz ˈizɪər wɪθ wɛt fit./
dialogue.zh: 腳是濕的，走坡道比較穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone here walks so slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌwʌn hɪr wɔks soʊ ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 這裡每個人走路都這麼慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fast feet bring cold water back.
dialogue.phonetic: /fæst fit brɪŋ koʊld ˈwɔtər bæk./
dialogue.zh: 走太快會把腳上的涼水又帶回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, robe tied, band on, hair up.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ roʊb taɪd bænd ɑn hɛr ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 好了，袍子繫好、手環戴好、頭髮綁好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you're dressed for the heat wing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jɔrz drɛst fɔr ðə hit wɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 那你這樣就穿對要去熱房區了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the heat wing the long hall?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə hit wɪŋ ðə lɔŋ hɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 熱房區就是那條長走廊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two doors, then the cedar smell.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu dɔrz ðɛn ðə ˈsidər smɛl./
dialogue.zh: 對，穿過兩扇門就聞到雪松味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Already my heart beats faster.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈrɛdi maɪ hɑrt bits ˈfæstər./
dialogue.zh: 才剛站穩，我的心跳就已經變快了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe out long, the heat will wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /brið aʊt lɔŋ ðə hit wil weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 長長地吐氣，熱氣會等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm going in, robe pockets empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ ɪn roʊb ˈpɑkɪts ˈɛmpti./
dialogue.zh: 我要進去了，袍子口袋空空。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The stones have been hot since two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stoʊnz hæv bɪn hɑt sɪns tu./
dialogue.zh: 那些石頭從兩點就開始燒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I sit on the top bench now?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ sɪt ɑn ðə tɑp bɛntʃ naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在可以坐上排嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put your towel down first, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt jɔr ˈtaʊəl daʊn fɜrst pliːz./
dialogue.zh: 請先把毛巾鋪在座位下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the bare wood hot on skin?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə bɛr wʊd hɑt ɑn skɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 木頭直接碰到皮膚會很燙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very, that's why we sit on cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri ðæts waɪ wi sɪt ɑn klɔθ./
dialogue.zh: 非常燙，所以我們都墊著布坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many minutes for my first round?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈmɪnɪts fɔr maɪ fɜrst raʊnd?/
dialogue.zh: 我第一回該待幾分鐘？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three is plenty, the hourglass sits there.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ɪz ˈplɛnti ði ˈaʊərˌglæs sɪts ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 三分鐘就夠了，沙漏就擺在旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I turn the hourglass myself?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ tɜrn ði ˈaʊərˌglæs maɪˈsɛlf?/
dialogue.zh: 沙漏要自己轉過來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and start it when you sit down.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd stɑrt ɪt wɛn ju sɪt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 對，你坐下的那一刻就讓它開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone is pouring water on stones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌwʌn ɪz ˈpɔrɪŋ ˈwɔtər ɑn stoʊnz./
dialogue.zh: 有人正在往石塊上倒水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She asked first, that's the rule here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi æskt fɜrst ðæts ðə rul hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 她有先問一聲，這就是這裡的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pour, if I ask aloud?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ pɔr ɪf aɪ æsk əˈlaʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我開口問一句，我也能倒水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it twice, then one small ladle.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ɪt twaɪs ðɛn wʌn smɔl ˈlædəl./
dialogue.zh: 說兩次讓大家都聽到，再舀一小瓢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the water make the room hotter?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈwɔtər meɪk ðə rum ˈhɑtər?/
dialogue.zh: 倒了水會讓房間更熱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The stones answer with one big wave.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stoʊnz ˈænsər wɪð wʌn bɪɡ weɪv./
dialogue.zh: 石塊會回給你一大層熱浪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I closed the door, is that right?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kloʊzd ðə dɔr ɪz ðæt raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我把門關上了，這樣對了沒？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gently, the heat escapes through every gap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒɛntli ðə hit ɪˈskeɪps θru ˈɛvəri ɡæp./
dialogue.zh: 輕輕關就好，熱氣會從每一條縫逃走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I talk with the man next to me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tɔk wɪð ðə mæn nɛkst tə mi?/
dialogue.zh: 我該跟坐我旁邊那位先生聊天嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Whispers only, he has his eyes shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪspərz ˈoʊnli hi hæz hɪz aɪz ʃʌt./
dialogue.zh: 只能小小聲，他眼睛都閉著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I keep my band in here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ kip maɪ bænd ɪn hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我的手環可以留在裡面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The band is fine, the phone is not.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bænd ɪz faɪn ðə foʊn ɪz nɑt./
dialogue.zh: 手環沒問題，手機就是不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wood smells stronger when it's warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wʊd smɛlz ˈstrɔŋɡər wɛn ɪts wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 木頭的氣味一熱起來變得很重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cedar wakes up with every round.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsidər weɪks ʌp wɪð ˈɛvəri raʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 雪松每做一回就醒過來一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I rub oil on my arms now?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ rʌb ɔɪl ɑn maɪ ɑrmz naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以現在在身上抹油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not inside; oil on the stones smells bad.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ɪnˈsaɪd ɔɪl ɑn ðə stoʊnz smɛlz bæd./
dialogue.zh: 裡面不行；油滴到石頭會很難聞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So oil waits until the shower?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɔɪl weɪts ʌnˈtɪl ðə ˈʃaʊər?/
dialogue.zh: 所以精油要等到沖完澡以後？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wash first, then oil on warm skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑʃ fɜrst ðɛn ɔɪl ɑn wɔrm skɪn./
dialogue.zh: 先洗乾淨，再把油抹在還熱的皮膚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right now my face feels like it is burning.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt naʊ maɪ feɪs filz laɪk ɪt ɪz ˈbɜrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 這會兒我的臉感覺像在發燒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the top air; move one bench down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə tɑp ɛr muv wʌn bɛntʃ daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 那是最上層的熱氣，往下挪一個座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the wool cap really needed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə wʊl kæp ˈrɪli ˈnidəd?/
dialogue.zh: 毛帽真的非戴不可嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps your hair dry and your head calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kips jɔr hɛr draɪ ænd jɔr hɛd kɑm./
dialogue.zh: 它讓頭髮保持乾，頭也比較沉得住氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who watches the sauna all evening?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ˈwɑtʃɪz ðə ˈsaʊnə ɔl ˈivnɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 整個傍晚是誰在照顧桑拿？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ben, he checks the stones every half hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛn hi tʃɛks ðə stoʊnz ˈɛvəri hæf ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 阿本，他每半小時來看一次石塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the glass wall showing the garden?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə glæs wɔl ˈʃoʊɪŋ ðə ˈgɑrdən?/
dialogue.zh: 玻璃牆外面看得到花園嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snow pines, and one bird on the rail.
dialogue.phonetic: /snoʊ paɪnz ænd wʌn bɜrd ɑn ðə reɪl./
dialogue.zh: 有沾雪的松樹，還有一隻鳥停在欄杆上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to look, is that allowed?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tə lʊk ɪz ðæt əˈlaʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 我想回頭看一眼，這樣可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn your head slowly, the wood is hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn jɔr hɛd ˈsloʊli ðə wʊd ɪz hɑt./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢轉頭就好，木頭很燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, my legs feel heavy already.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ maɪ lɛɡz fil ˈhɛvi ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 哇，我的兩條腿已經很沉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then stand up slow and sit outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn stænd ʌp sloʊ ænd sɪt ˌaʊtˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 那就慢慢站起來，去外面坐一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bench outside is metal, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛntʃ ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ɪz ˈmɛtəl ðoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 外頭那張長椅是金屬做的吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It has a wood top, rest your feet high.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hæz ə wʊd tɑp rɛst jɔr fit haɪ./
dialogue.zh: 椅面鋪了木板，把腳抬高歇著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I dry off between the rounds?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ draɪ ɔf bɪˈtwin ðə raʊndz?/
dialogue.zh: 兩回之間我要把自己擦乾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One quick pat, sweat keeps the heat close.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kwɪk pæt swɛt kips ðə hit kloʊs./
dialogue.zh: 輕輕拍一下就好，汗會幫你把熱留住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do I rest between heats?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ du aɪ rɛst bɪˈtwin hits?/
dialogue.zh: 兩回中間我該休息多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: As long as you feel warm, no clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /æz lɔŋ æz ju fil wɔrm noʊ klɑk./
dialogue.zh: 只要你身上還暖著就算，沒有時鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If I feel dizzy, what do I do?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ fil ˈdɪzi wʌt du aɪ du?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我覺得頭暈，我該怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say dizzy aloud, we come right in.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ˈdɪzi əˈlaʊd wi kʌm raɪt ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 大聲說一聲頭暈，我們會立刻進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I leave after one minute?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ liv ˈæftər wʌn ˈmɪnɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 才一分鐘我就可以離開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, the room keeps no score.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs ðə rum kips noʊ skɔr./
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，那間房不替你計分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two people came in at once.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈpipəl keɪm ɪn æt wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 剛剛有兩個人同時走進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight fit fine, and the door closes soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt fɪt faɪn ænd ðə dɔr ˈkloʊzɪz sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 八個座位坐得下，門會輕輕關上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wait if the room is full?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ weɪt ɪf ðə rum ɪz fʊl?/
dialogue.zh: 如果裡面已經滿了，我要等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit on the cool step and count to ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt ɑn ðə kul stɛp ænd kaʊnt tə tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 坐在外面涼的那一階，數到十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oops, my towel slid off the bench.
dialogue.phonetic: /ups maɪ ˈtaʊəl slɪd ɔf ðə bɛntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，我的毛巾從長椅上滑下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fold it once, the wood is very smooth.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊld ɪt wʌns ðə wʊd ɪz ˈvɛri smuð./
dialogue.zh: 把它摺一次再鋪，木頭很滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three rounds, is that truly enough?
dialogue.phonetic: /θri raʊndz ɪz ðæt ˈtruːli ɪˈnʌf?/
dialogue.zh: 今天三回真的夠了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For today, three rounds is the plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr təˈdeɪ θri raʊndz ɪz ðə plæn./
dialogue.zh: 就今天而言，三回就是全部的安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The heat here is different from steam.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hit hɪr ɪz ˈdɪfərənt frʌm stim./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的熱感覺跟蒸氣室不同。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry heat pulls, wet heat just wraps you.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ hit pʊlz wɛt hit dʒʌst ræps ju./
dialogue.zh: 乾熱是在往外拉，濕熱只是把你包住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I bring water inside the room?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ brɪŋ ˈwɔtər ɪnˈsaɪd ðə rum?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把水帶進房間裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cups wait on the shelf just outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌps weɪt ɑn ðə ʃɛlf dʒʌst ˌaʊtˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 杯子就擱在門外的小架上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd like a cup between rounds, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk ə kʌp bɪˈtwin raʊndz ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那我兩回之間想要喝杯水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half a cup, cold, small sips only.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ə kʌp koʊld smɔl sɪps ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 半杯就好，涼的，一小口一小口喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is silence a rule, or just a habit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈsaɪləns ə rul ɔr dʒʌst ə ˈhæbɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 安靜算是規矩，還是大家的習慣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A habit here; the bell ends each round.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈhæbɪt hɪr ðə bɛl ɛndz itʃ raʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡算習慣；每回結束會搖鈴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a bell at the end?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə bɛl æt ði ɛnd?/
dialogue.zh: 結束的時候會有一聲鈴？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One low tone, then you may rise.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn loʊ toʊn ðɛn ju meɪ raɪz./
dialogue.zh: 一聲壓得很低的鈴，然後你就能起身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The stones made a loud crack just now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stoʊnz meɪd ə laʊd kræk dʒʌst naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 石塊剛剛很大聲地裂了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the water meeting a hot corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈwɔtər ˈmitɪŋ ə hɑt ˈkɔrnər./
dialogue.zh: 那是水正好澆到最燙的那一角。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I say thank you when I leave?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ seɪ θæŋk ju wɛn aɪ liv?/
dialogue.zh: 我離開的時候要說謝謝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small nod is enough in there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl nɑd ɪz ɪˈnʌf ɪn ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 在裡頭輕輕點一下頭就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nearly done, this first round.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɪrli dʌn ðɪs fɜrst raʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 第一輪差不多做完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand slow, the floor holds the heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd sloʊ ðə flɔr hoʊldz ðə hit./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢站起來，地板把熱都留住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I rinse right after the sauna?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ rɪns raɪt ˈæftər ðə ˈsaʊnə?/
dialogue.zh: 桑拿結束後我該馬上沖水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool rinse first, then your feet go cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /kul rɪns fɜrst ðɛn jɔr fit goʊ koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 先沖一遍涼水，接著你的腳會更冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the cold pool is next, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə koʊld pul ɪz nɛkst ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 所以下一站就是那個冷水池？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, warm shoulders, cold water, brave now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɔrm ˈʃoʊldərz koʊld ˈwɔtər breɪv naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 對，熱的肩膀配冷的水，現在要勇敢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel brave, but only a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil breɪv bʌt ˈoʊnli ə ˈlɪtəl./
dialogue.zh: 我覺得自己很勇敢，但只有一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little is exactly what we need.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt wi nid./
dialogue.zh: 有一點點就剛好是我們要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See how red my skin is now?
dialogue.phonetic: /si haʊ rɛd maɪ skɪn ɪz naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 你看我現在的皮膚有多紅？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means the heat did its work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ðə hit dɪd ɪts wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 那代表熱氣已經把活兒做完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I sweat more in the wool cap?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ swɛt mɔr ɪn ðə wʊl kæp?/
dialogue.zh: 戴著毛帽我會流更多汗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cap takes it off your forehead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kæp teɪks ɪt ɔf jɔr ˈfɔrˌhɛd./
dialogue.zh: 帽子會幫你的額頭把汗帶走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bench under me is very warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛntʃ ˈʌndər mi ɪz ˈvɛri wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 我坐的這一排木椅好燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lower benches wait for the shy ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈloʊər ˈbɛntʃɪz weɪt fɔr ðə ʃaɪ wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 下排那些座位是留給怕熱的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I move to the lower bench now?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ muv tə ðə ˈloʊər bɛntʃ naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在可以往下排挪過去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step down facing the door, never the stones.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛp daʊn ˈfeɪsɪŋ ðə dɔr ˈnɛvər ðə stoʊnz./
dialogue.zh: 面朝門跨下去，千萬別背對石塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more round, then the cold water.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr raʊnd ðɛn ðə koʊld ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 再做一回，然後就去沖冷水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two more, maybe, if you feel steady.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mɔr ˈmeɪbi ɪf ju fil ˈstɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 如果你站得穩，也許還能兩回。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel steady, just very thirsty.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil ˈstɛdi dʒʌst ˈvɛri ˈθɜrsti./
dialogue.zh: 我站得很穩，只是非常渴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cup shelf waits by the second door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kʌp ʃɛlf weɪts baɪ ðə ˈsɛkənd dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 杯架就在第二扇門那裡等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this room get noisy later?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðɪs rum ɡɛt ˈnɔɪzi ˈleɪtər?/
dialogue.zh: 這間後來會不會變吵？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six o'clock brings talkers, we ask them out.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ə ˈklɑk brɪŋz ˈtɔkərz wi æsk ðɛm aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 六點會來愛聊天的人，我們會請他們出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for the rules, they help.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fɔr ðə rulz ðeɪ hɛlp./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你跟我說明這些規矩，很有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most guests learn it in two rounds.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ɡɛsts lɜrn ɪt ɪn tu raʊndz./
dialogue.zh: 多數客人做兩回就全都學會了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, my hourglass just turned all the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt maɪ ˈaʊərˌɡlæs dʒʌst tɜrnd ɔl ðə weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 對了，我的沙漏剛剛整個漏完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then your first round is officially done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jɔr fɜrst raʊnd ɪz əˈfɪʃəli dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 那你的第一回就正式結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, cool bench, then the cold pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ kul bɛntʃ ðɛn ðə koʊld pul./
dialogue.zh: 好，先去涼椅，然後是冷水池。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk the short hall, the door is open.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk ðə ʃɔrt hɔl ðə dɔr ɪz ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 走這條短的走廊，門已經開著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can see steam rising from water.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kən si stim ˈraɪzɪŋ frʌm ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 我看得到水面上有熱氣在升。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the plunge edge, blue and very still.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə plʌndʒ ɛdʒ blu ænd ˈvɛri stɪl./
dialogue.zh: 那就是冷水池的邊，藍色，非常靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How cold is this water, in numbers?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ koʊld ɪz ðɪs ˈwɔtər ɪn ˈnʌmbərz?/
dialogue.zh: 這池水到底是幾度？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight degrees, the wall says it plainly.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt dɪˈgriːz ðə wɔl sɛz ɪt ˈpleɪnli./
dialogue.zh: 八度，牆上的數字寫得清清楚楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight degrees feels like ice to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt dɪˈɡriːz filz laɪk aɪs tə mi./
dialogue.zh: 八度對我來說根本是冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is ice, that's why it works.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz aɪs ðæts waɪ ɪt wɜrks./
dialogue.zh: 它就是冰，所以才有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should my head go under too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd maɪ hɛd goʊ ˈʌndər tu?/
dialogue.zh: 我的頭也要一起浸進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, chin up, the neck stays out.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tʃɪn ʌp ðə nɛk steɪz aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 不用，下巴抬高，頸部留在水外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which step do I take down there?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ stɛp du aɪ teɪk daʊn ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 我進去的時候要先踩哪一階？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The first two steps, then you stand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɜrst tu stɛps ðɛn ju stænd./
dialogue.zh: 先踩下面兩階，然後站住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still hot, these shoulders from the sauna.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl hɑt ðiz ˈʃoʊldərz frʌm ðə ˈsaʊnə./
dialogue.zh: 從桑拿出來，肩膀還是燙的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, hot skin makes the cold easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt hɑt skɪn meɪks ðə koʊld ˈizi./
dialogue.zh: 正好，皮膚熱的時候冷水就比較不難。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I splash water on myself first?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ splæʃ ˈwɔtər ɑn maɪˈsɛlf fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 我要先往自己身上潑水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, wrists and ankles, then the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs rɪsts ænd ˈæŋkəlz ðɛn ðə rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 要，先手腕和腳踝，再來是其他部位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a small cup by the edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə smɔl kʌp baɪ ði ɛdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 池邊放了一個舀水的小杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use it on your neck, slowly back.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ɪt ɑn jɔr nɛk ˈsloʊli bæk./
dialogue.zh: 用它澆你的頸後，慢慢往下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm in up to my elbows now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ɪn ʌp tə maɪ ˈɛlˌboʊz naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我現在浸到手肘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two more steps and the water finds your chest.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mɔr stɛps ænd ðə ˈwɔtər faɪndz jɔr tʃɛst./
dialogue.zh: 再往下兩階，水就會碰到你的胸口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that air left my body.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæt ɛr lɛft maɪ ˈbɑdi./
dialogue.zh: 啊，我那口氣整個被擠出去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe out for four counts, long and slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /brið aʊt fɔr fɔr kaʊnts lɔŋ ænd sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 吐氣數到四，要長、要慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My fingers sting, is that normal?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈfɪŋɡərz stɪŋ ɪz ðæt ˈnɔrməl?/
dialogue.zh: 我的手指在刺痛，這正常嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very normal, they'll wake up soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri ˈnɔrməl ðeɪl weɪk ʌp sun./
dialogue.zh: 非常正常，一下子就會醒過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long should I stay in this time?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ʃʊd aɪ steɪ ɪn ðɪs taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 這一次我該浸多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty seconds, I'll count them out loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛkəndz aɪl kaʊnt ðɛm aʊt laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 二十秒，我會大聲替你數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Counting helps, I didn't think it would.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaʊntɪŋ hɛlps aɪ dɪdnt θɪŋk ɪt wʊd./
dialogue.zh: 有人數真的有幫助，我原以為不會。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One, two, three, you're doing fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tu θri jʊrz duɪŋ faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 一、二、三，你做得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six already, this feels like an age.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɔlˈrɛdi ðɪs filz laɪk ən edʒ./
dialogue.zh: 才六秒就覺得像過了很久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten more, then we walk you out.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn mɔr ðɛn wi wɔk ju aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 再十秒，然後我們就陪你走出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to jump, but I won't.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tə dʒʌmp bʌt aɪ woʊnt./
dialogue.zh: 我有點想跳下去，但不會跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never jump, the tiles are very slick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər dʒʌmp ðə ˈtaɪlərz ɑr ˈvɛri slɪk./
dialogue.zh: 絕對別跳，池邊的磚很滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then my breath came back at fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn maɪ brɛθ keɪm bæk æt ˌfɪfˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 數到十五的時候，我的呼吸回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the moment most people smile.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈmoʊmənt moʊst ˈpipəl smaɪl./
dialogue.zh: 那正是多數人開始笑的瞬間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I really smiling right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ ˈrɪli ˈsmaɪlɪŋ raɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在真的在笑嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are, and your shoulders came down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ænd jɔr ˈʃoʊldərz keɪm daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 是啊，而且你的肩膀整個鬆下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, twenty, I'm coming out now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈtwɛnti aɪm ˈkʌmɪŋ aʊt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好，二十秒了，我要走出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slowly, hold the rail with your left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsloʊli hoʊld ðə reɪl wɪð jɔr lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，左邊扶著欄杆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The air outside feels warm on me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɛr ˌaʊtˈsaɪd filz wɔrm ɑn mi./
dialogue.zh: 走出來以後，空氣碰在身上居然是暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the trick, the room hasn't changed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə trɪk ðə rum ˈhæzənt tʃeɪndʒd./
dialogue.zh: 這就是它的戲法，房間溫度根本沒變。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I have a towel this second?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ hæv ə ˈtaʊəl ðɪs ˈsɛkənd?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在馬上需要一條毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The warm pile is at your elbow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɔrm paɪl ɪz æt jɔr ˈɛlˌboʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那一疊熱毛巾就在你手肘邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wrapped both arms and my neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ræpt boʊθ ɑrmz ænd maɪ nɛk./
dialogue.zh: 我把兩條手臂和頸部都裹起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the robe, and sit on the mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə roʊb ænd sɪt ɑn ðə mæt./
dialogue.zh: 接著穿上袍子，坐在那張墊子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mat under me is heated.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mæt ˈʌndər mi ɪz ˈhitɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我坐的這張墊子是加熱過的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Low heat, it finishes what the robe starts.
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ hit ɪt ˈfɪnɪʃɪz wʌt ðə roʊb stɑrts./
dialogue.zh: 溫溫的熱，袍子起頭，它負責收尾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Out here, my heart is beating fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt hɪr maɪ hɑrt ɪz ˈbitɪŋ fæst./
dialogue.zh: 走出來以後，我的心跳還在很快地衝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it two minutes, the tea helps too.
dialogue.phonetic: /gɪv ɪt tu ˈmɪnɪts ðə ti hɛlps tu./
dialogue.zh: 給它兩分鐘，喝杯茶也會幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I go back in a second time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ɡoʊ bæk ɪn ə ˈsɛkənd taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 我該再回去浸第二次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, once more, and it's much easier.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌns mɔr ænd ɪts mʌtʃ ˈizɪər./
dialogue.zh: 該，再來一次，會容易太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easier is a strong word for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizɪər ɪz ə strɔŋ wɜrd fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 「容易」這兩個字對我而言太誇了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the second round, then judge us.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə ˈsɛkənd raʊnd ðɛn dʒʌdʒ ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 先做第二次，再來評論我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here I go, one breath, then down.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr aɪ ɡoʊ wʌn brɛθ ðɛn daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 我要過去了，吸一口氣，然後往下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, your chin stayed up this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd jɔr tʃɪn steɪd ʌp ðɪs taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 很好，這回你的下巴沒有沉下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I counted to thirty by myself.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkaʊntɪd tə ˈθɜrdi baɪ maɪˈsɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 我自己數到了三十秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty is brave, we don't ask that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrdi ɪz breɪv wi doʊnt æsk ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 三十秒很勇，我們其實不要求這麼多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Getting out feels harder than getting in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɛtɪŋ aʊt filz ˈhɑrdər ðæn ˈɡɛtɪŋ ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 走出水池比走進去還難。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the rail, push with both heels.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə reɪl pʊʃ wɪθ boʊθ hilz./
dialogue.zh: 抓穩欄杆，用兩隻腳跟往下蹬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Huh, my knees feel a little shaky.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌh maɪ niz fil ə ˈlɪtəl ˈʃeɪki./
dialogue.zh: 咦，我的膝蓋有點在抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit on the step, the blood will settle.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt ɑn ðə stɛp ðə blʌd wil ˈsɛtl./
dialogue.zh: 坐在階上，血氣一下子就會順。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is that iron bucket on the wall?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðæt ˈaɪərn ˈbʌkɪt ɑn ðə wɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 牆上那個鐵桶是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A cold shower for your legs only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə koʊld ˈʃaʊər fɔr jɔr lɛɡz ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 那是只沖腿的冷水淋浴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pull the chain myself?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ pʊl ðə tʃeɪn maɪˈsɛlf?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以自己拉那條鏈子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn the handle, start at your feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə ˈhændəl stɑrt æt jɔr fit./
dialogue.zh: 轉那個把手就好，從腳開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bucket water is colder than the pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbʌkɪt ˈwɔtər ɪz ˈkoʊldər ðæn ðə pul./
dialogue.zh: 桶裡的水比池子還冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By one degree, and it feels like ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ wʌn dɪˈɡri ænd ɪt filz laɪk tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 只多一度，可是感覺像差了十度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did my legs, that was enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd maɪ lɛɡz ðæt wʌz ɪˈnʌf./
dialogue.zh: 我沖完腿了，這樣就夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enough is exactly the right amount here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈnʌf ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli ðə raɪt əˈmaʊnt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，剛剛夠就是最正確的份量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a warm pool next to it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə wɔrm pul nɛkst tə ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 它旁邊有一個溫水池。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest your arms in it, not your feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst jɔr ɑrmz ɪn ɪt nɑt jɔr fit./
dialogue.zh: 把手臂擱進去泡著，腳就不要了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm and cold, back and forth?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ænd koʊld bæk ænd fɔrθ?/
dialogue.zh: 一下溫的、一下冷的，來回交換嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two switches, then stop while you're warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈswɪtʃɪz ðɛn stɑp waɪl jʊr wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 來回兩次就好，身體還暖就停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like the switch, it feels alive.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ðə swɪtʃ ɪt filz əˈlaɪv./
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡這個來回，渾身像活過來一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people do, then they ask for tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpipəl du ðɛn ðeɪ æsk fɔr ti./
dialogue.zh: 多數人都這樣，然後就開始要茶喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tea, yes, that is my next stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ti jɛs ðæt ɪz maɪ nɛkst stɑp./
dialogue.zh: 茶，對，那是我下一站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the ramp, the lounge is upstairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə ræmp ðə laʊndʒ ɪz ˌʌpˈstɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 走坡道上樓，喝茶區就在上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My skin still tingles from the cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ skɪn stɪl ˈtɪŋɡəlz frʌm ðə koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 我的皮膚還在因為冷水而發麻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it five, the feeling comes back soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /gɪv ɪt faɪv ðə ˈfilɪŋ kʌmz bæk sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 再等五分鐘，知覺會輕輕地回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are wet feet a problem on the ramp?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr wɛt fit ə ˈprɑbləm ɑn ðə ræmp?/
dialogue.zh: 濕腳走坡道會不會有問題？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk slow, the ramp has grip strips.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk sloʊ ðə ræmp hæz ɡrɪp strɪps./
dialogue.zh: 走慢些，坡道上有一條條防滑紋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I didn't think I could do that.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪdnt θɪŋk aɪ kʊd du ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 我本來以為我做不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did twice, and you'll remember that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dɪd twaɪs ænd jʊl rɪˈmɛmbər ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 你做兩次了，你會記住這件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three rounds in the sauna, all done now.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri raʊndz ɪn ðə ˈsaʊnə ɔl dʌn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 桑拿那三回，現在全都做完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hot first, then the cold does the work.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑt fɜrst ðɛn ðə koʊld dʌz ðə wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 先讓熱到位，剩下的活交給冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone else is waiting for the pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌwʌn ɛls ɪz ˈweɪtɪŋ fɔr ðə pul./
dialogue.zh: 有別人在等著用那個池子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He waits his turn, you had yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi weɪts hɪz tɜrn ju hæd jɔrz./
dialogue.zh: 他排隊輪他，你已經輪過你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was I in the water too long?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz aɪ ɪn ðə ˈwɔtər tu lɔŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 我在水裡待得太久了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two minutes, right on the plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɪnɪts raɪt ɑn ðə plæn./
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘，跟安排一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My glasses fogged up completely.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈglæsɪz fɔɡd ʌp kəmˈplitli./
dialogue.zh: 我的眼鏡整個起霧了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave them on the rail shelf next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ðɛm ɑn ðə reɪl ʃɛlf nɛkst taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 下一回就把它們放在欄杆的小架上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time, will you be here again?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm wɪl ju bi hɪr əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 下一回你還會在這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I stay by the pool until six.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ steɪ baɪ ðə pul ʌnˈtɪl sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 我會守著池子到六點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I might need one more push.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd aɪ maɪt nid wʌn mɔr pʊʃ./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，也許我還需要再被推一把。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
