dialogue.text: You won't, the next one is easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju woʊnt ðə nɛkst wʌn ɪz ˈizi./
dialogue.zh: 不用了，下一趟就會很輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easy, that's a word I like here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi ðæts ə wɜrd aɪ laɪk hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 「輕鬆」，這是我在這裡最喜歡的詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it, we have a warm robe too.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt wi hæv ə wɔrm roʊb tu./
dialogue.zh: 記住它吧，我們這裡也有暖過的袍子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take the robe and the long hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk ðə roʊb ænd ðə lɔŋ hɔl./
dialogue.zh: 我要那件袍子，還有那條長走廊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go slow, the tiles are still damp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ sloʊ ðə ˈtaɪlərz ɑr stɪl dæmp./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢走，地上的磚還濕著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are warm again, finally.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hændz ɑr wɔrm əˈɡɛn ˈfaɪnəli./
dialogue.zh: 我的手終於又回暖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's your sign to sit and breathe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts jɔr saɪn tə sɪt ænd brið./
dialogue.zh: 那就是可以坐下來呼吸的暗號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sitting, breathing, and a little proud too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪtɪŋ ˈbriðɪŋ ænd ə ˈlɪtəl praʊd tu./
dialogue.zh: 坐著、呼吸，還有那麼一點驕傲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Proud is right, the plunge is the hard one.
dialogue.phonetic: /praʊd ɪz raɪt ðə plʌndʒ ɪz ðə hɑrd wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 驕傲是應該的，那池冷水才是最難的一關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, where is that tea counter again?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wɛr ɪz ðæt ti ˈkaʊntər əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，那個茶台又在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Up the ramp, past the soft chairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌp ðə ræmp pæst ðə sɔft tʃɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 沿坡道往上，經過那排軟椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One ramp up, and the tea smell found me.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ræmp ʌp ænd ðə ti smɛl faʊnd mi./
dialogue.zh: 一道坡道走上來，茶香就把我找到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The counter is on your right, all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkaʊntər ɪz ɑn jɔr raɪt ɔl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 倒茶那張台就在你右手邊，整天都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the ginger tea still hot in that pot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈdʒɪndʒər ti stɪl hɑt ɪn ðæt pɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 那壺薑茶還熱著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pot four, and yes, it's been steeping.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɑt fɔr ænd jɛs ɪts bɪn ˈstipɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 四號壺，熱著呢，一直在泡到現在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steeping since when, if I may ask?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstipɪŋ sɪns wɛn ɪf aɪ meɪ æsk?/
dialogue.zh: 泡了多久了，我能問一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hour, the leaves are strong now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈaʊər ðə livz ɑr strɔŋ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 一小時了，茶葉現在味道最足。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This clay cup is heavy in my hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs kleɪ kʌp ɪz ˈhɛvi ɪn maɪ hændz./
dialogue.zh: 這只陶土杯在我手裡沉甸甸的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heavy cups make slow hands, that's the point.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛvi kʌps meɪk sloʊ hændz ðæts ðə pɔɪnt./
dialogue.zh: 杯子重，手就會慢下來，這是故意的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I add honey to the ginger?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ æd ˈhʌni tə ðə ˈdʒɪndʒər?/
dialogue.zh: 薑茶裡要加蜂蜜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A thin spoon, the tea is already sweet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə θɪn spuːn ðə ti ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi swit./
dialogue.zh: 加一小匙就好，茶本身已經帶甜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there any caffeine in this one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ˈɛni ˌkæfəˈin ɪn ðɪs wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 這一壺裡面有沒有咖啡因？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None in ginger, none in the chamomile.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌn ɪn ˈdʒɪndʒər nʌn ɪn ðə kæˈmɑmɪl./
dialogue.zh: 薑茶沒有，洋甘菊茶也沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then chamomile later, when I go home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kæˈmɑmɪl ˈleɪtər wɛn aɪ ɡoʊ hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 那洋甘菊留到回家晚上再喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We sell it in small paper packets.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi sɛl ɪt ɪn smɔl ˈpeɪpər ˈpækɪts./
dialogue.zh: 我們有小包裝，可以買一包帶走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I pick any of these long chairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ pɪk ˈɛni ʌv ðiz lɔŋ tʃɛrz?/
dialogue.zh: 這排長椅我可以隨便挑一張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one by the window faces the pines.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wʌn baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ˈfeɪsɪz ðə paɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 靠窗那一張，正面就對著松樹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this chair lie all the way back?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðɪs tʃɛr laɪ ɔl ðə weɪ bæk?/
dialogue.zh: 這張椅子能夠完全躺平嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push the arm rest, the foot comes up.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ði ɑrm rɛst ðə fʊt kʌmz ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 壓一下扶手，抬腳那段就會起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And a blanket, is that one mine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ə ˈblæŋkɪt ɪz ðæt wʌn maɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 還有那條毛毯，是給我的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wool, folded warm, take the grey one.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊl ˈfoʊldəd wɔrm teɪk ðə ɡreɪ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 羊毛的，摺好擱在暖處，拿灰色那條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The blanket smells faintly of cedar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈblæŋkɪt smɛlz ˈfeɪntli ʌv ˈsidər./
dialogue.zh: 毯子上有一點淡淡的雪松味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The drying room shares its air with it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdraɪɪŋ rum ʃɛrz ɪts ɛr wɪð ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 烘毛巾的房間跟它共用同一室的空氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I set a clock before I rest?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ sɛt ə klɑk bɪˈfɔr aɪ rɛst?/
dialogue.zh: 我休息之前需要設定鬧鐘嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No clocks in here; we wake you at twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ klɑks ɪn hɪr wi weɪk ju æt ˈtwɛnti./
dialogue.zh: 這裡不收鬧鐘；二十分鐘我們會叫你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, then a soft call?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts ðɛn ə sɔft kɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘之後會有一聲輕輕的喚？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One chime, very low, nobody startles.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tʃaɪm ˈvɛri loʊ ˈnoʊˌbɑdi ˈstɑrtəlz./
dialogue.zh: 一聲低低的鈴，不會嚇到任何人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I leave the cup on the floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ liv ðə kʌp ɑn ðə flɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以先把杯子擱在地上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The side table waits beside your left hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə saɪd ˈteɪbəl weɪts bəˈsaɪd jɔr lɛft hænd./
dialogue.zh: 你左手邊有張小桌，放那兒就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The light here is low and amber.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪt hɪr ɪz loʊ ænd ˈæmbər./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的光壓得很低，是琥珀色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Amber keeps the eyes half closed, on purpose.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæmbər kips ði aɪz hæf kloʊzd ɑn ˈpɜrpəs./
dialogue.zh: 琥珀色讓眼睛半閉，這是刻意安排的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a sound like far water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə saʊnd laɪk fɑr ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 有一種像很遠的水聲在響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small fountain behind the stone wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl ˈfaʊntən bɪˈhaɪnd ðə stoʊn wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 石牆後面藏著一座小噴泉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you play music in the lounge?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju pleɪ ˈmjuzɪk ɪn ðə laʊndʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 喝茶區會撥音樂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never; water and breathing fill the space.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər ˈwɔtər ænd ˈbriðɪŋ fɪl ðə speɪs./
dialogue.zh: 從不；水聲和呼吸就把空間填滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Somehow my thoughts have slowed down a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌhaʊ maɪ θɔts hæv sloʊd daʊn ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 不知怎麼的，我腦中的念頭已經慢了一大截。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the last round doing its work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə læst raʊnd duɪŋ ɪts wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 那是最後一回熱身正在替你做事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a second cup of tea allowed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ə ˈsɛkənd kʌp ʌv ti əˈlaʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 第二杯茶也是被允許的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three cups, and the pot is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri kʌps ænd ðə pɑt ɪz fri./
dialogue.zh: 三杯都行，壺裡的茶不再收錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone is snoring very gently there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌwʌn ɪz ˈsnɔrɪŋ ˈvɛri ˈdʒɛntli ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 那邊有人在很輕地打呼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the chair by the heater, allow it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə tʃɛr baɪ ðə ˈhitər əˈlaʊ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那是暖氣邊那張椅子，就讓他睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm trying not to laugh at it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈtraɪɪŋ nɑt tə læf æt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我正在忍著不笑出聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small laugh is fine, walls are soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl læf ɪz faɪn wɔlz ɑr sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 小小地笑沒關係，這裡的牆都吸音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under me my feet found the warm spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər mi maɪ fit faʊnd ðə wɔrm spɑt./
dialogue.zh: 我身子底下，腳找到了那塊暖的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heated mats, one under each long chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhitɪd mæts wʌn ˈʌndər itʃ lɔŋ tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 每張長椅底下都鋪了一塊加熱墊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it strange that I want to cry?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt streɪndʒ ðæt aɪ wɑnt tə kraɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 我有種想哭的衝動，這奇怪嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not at all, heat and cold move feelings.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt æt ɔl hit ænd koʊld muv ˈfilɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 一點也不，熱和冷會讓情緒跟著走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll just breathe and let it pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl dʒʌst brið ænd lɛt ɪt pæs./
dialogue.zh: 那我就好好呼吸，讓它過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two breaths, and the feeling moves on.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu brɛθs ænd ðə ˈfilɪŋ muvz ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 兩口氣之後，那個感覺自己會走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I close my eyes for ten?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ kloʊz maɪ aɪz fɔr tɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以閉上眼睛十分鐘嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chime will find you, sleep if you can.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃaɪm wil faɪnd ju slip ɪf ju kæn./
dialogue.zh: 鈴會找到你，能睡就睡一會兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A damp towel over my eyes helps a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dæmp ˈtaʊəl ˈoʊvər maɪ aɪz hɛlps ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 濕毛巾蓋在眼睛上特別有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Damp ones rest in the small green dish.
dialogue.phonetic: /dæmp wʌnz rɛst ɪn ðə smɔl ɡrin dɪʃ./
dialogue.zh: 濕的那幾條就擱在綠色淺盤裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pines outside move without any wind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə paɪnz ˌaʊtˈsaɪd muv wɪˈðaʊt ˈɛni wɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 窗外的松樹在沒有風的時候也在動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the river breeze, it comes at five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈrɪvər briːz ɪt kʌmz æt faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 那是河面上來的風，五點剛好吹到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five twenty is close, isn't it?
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈtwɛnti ɪz kloʊz ˈɪzənt ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 五點二十快到了，是不是？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four minutes, your face room is ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈmɪnɪts jɔr feɪs rum ɪz ˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 還有四分鐘，你的臉部房間已經備好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I don't want to give the blanket back.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ doʊnt wɑnt tə ɡiv ðə ˈblæŋkɪt bæk./
dialogue.zh: 我不想把這條毯子還回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it until the chime, no hurry.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt ʌnˈtɪl ðə tʃaɪm noʊ ˈhɜri./
dialogue.zh: 留到鈴響再說，不用急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This cup is warm inside my hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs kʌp ɪz wɔrm ɪnˈsaɪd maɪ hændz./
dialogue.zh: 我手裡的這個杯子還是溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clay holds heat twice as long as glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /kleɪ hoʊldz hit twaɪs æz lɔŋ æz glæs./
dialogue.zh: 陶土留住熱，比玻璃久上兩倍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do people really rest this long here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈpipəl ˈrɪli rɛst ðɪs lɔŋ hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 真的會有人在這裡休息這麼久嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lazy half hour is the best half.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈleɪzi hæf ˈaʊər ɪz ðə bɛst hæf./
dialogue.zh: 那偷閒的半小時，才是最好的半小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One rice cake, is that for guests?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn raɪs keɪk ɪz ðæt fɔr ɡɛsts?/
dialogue.zh: 那盤米糕是預留給客人的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the plate, with the sesame crust.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə pleɪt wɪð ðə ˈsɛsəmi krʌst./
dialogue.zh: 就在盤子上，外層裹著芝麻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's sweet, but only a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts swit bʌt ˈoʊnli ə ˈlɪtəl./
dialogue.zh: 甜甜的，但只有一點點而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Little is how we do everything here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪtəl ɪz haʊ wi du ˈɛvriθɪŋ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 「一點點」就是我們在這裡做事的方式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Down here my socks dried on the heated mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn hɪr maɪ sɑks draɪd ɑn ðə ˈhitɪd mæt./
dialogue.zh: 暖墊上，我的襪子已經全乾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, cotton socks make a quiet exit.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd ˈkɑtən sɑks meɪk ə ˈkwaɪət ˈɛɡzɪt./
dialogue.zh: 很好，棉襪讓你離開時一聲不響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hear the plunge door open and shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɪr ðə plʌndʒ dɔr ˈoʊpən ænd ʃʌt./
dialogue.zh: 我聽到冷水池那扇門開了又關。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Someone brave, right before your face room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmwʌn breɪv raɪt bɪˈfɔr jɔr feɪs rum./
dialogue.zh: 又一個人很勇敢，就在你進按摩房之前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I brave, or only sleepy now?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ breɪv ɔr ˈoʊnli ˈslipi naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在算是勇敢，還是只想睡覺？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleepy counts as brave in this building.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslipi kaʊnts æz breɪv ɪn ðɪs ˈbɪldɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 在這棟房子裡，想睡也算勇敢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The chair tipped me back one more notch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃɛr tɪpt mi bæk wʌn mɔr nɑtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 椅子又往後多傾了一格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it tip, your head should hang low.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt tɪp jɔr hɛd ʃʊd hæŋ loʊ./
dialogue.zh: 讓它傾吧，你的頭原本就該垂低一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My neck feels longer than this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ nɛk filz ˈlɔŋɡər ðæn ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我的頸子比今天早上還長了一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heat came here to loosen that neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /hit keɪm hɪr tə ˈlusən ðæt nɛk./
dialogue.zh: 熱氣跑這一趟，就是為了鬆開你的頸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I finish this cup before five twenty?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃ ðɪs kʌp bɪˈfɔr faɪv ˈtwɛnti?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在五點二十前把這杯喝完嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the therapist will wait one minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈθɛrəpɪst wil weɪt wʌn ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 可以，那位按摩師會等你一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The room is still, I hear my pulse.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rum ɪz stɪl aɪ hɪr maɪ pʌls./
dialogue.zh: 房間靜到我聽得見自己的脈搏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow pulse, warm hands, that's the tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ pʌls wɔrm hændz ðæts ðə ti./
dialogue.zh: 脈慢、手暖，那就是茶的功勞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I could stay in this chair all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kʊd steɪ ɪn ðɪs tʃɛr ɔl naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我可以在這張椅子上坐到半夜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chime will disagree, gently, at twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃaɪm wil ˌdɪsəˈɡri ˈdʒɛntli æt ˈtwɛnti./
dialogue.zh: 那聲鈴會溫柔地反對，它定在二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more minute of doing nothing, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr ˈmɪnɪt ʌv duɪŋ ˈnʌθɪŋ ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 再讓我發一分鐘呆，然後就走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take two, I'll leave the cup right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk tu aɪl liv ðə kʌp raɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 給你兩分鐘，杯子我就放在你旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leave it, my hands aren't fully warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt maɪ hændz ɑrənt ˈfʊli wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 放著吧，我的手還沒有完全回溫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The mat will do that in two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mæt wil du ðæt ɪn tu./
dialogue.zh: 墊子兩分鐘就能把最後那點冷趕走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two minutes, then the green hall, then four.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɪnɪts ðɛn ðə ɡrin hɔl ðɛn fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘後，走綠色走廊，然後進四號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four is the small room with the lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ɪz ðə smɔl rum wɪð ðə læmp./
dialogue.zh: 四號就是那間擺著小燈的小房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does this cup go when I'm done?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ðɪs kʌp ɡoʊ wɛn aɪm dʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 喝完的杯子最後要放到哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tray by the pot, no washing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə treɪ baɪ ðə pɑt noʊ ˈwɑʃɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 放在茶壺邊的托盤，不用自己清洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No washing, that's a kind rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɑʃɪŋ ðæts ə kaɪnd rul./
dialogue.zh: 不用自己洗，這規矩真體貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We wash a hundred cups every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɑʃ ə ˈhʌndrəd kʌps ˈɛvri deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我們每天本來就要洗一百個杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A hundred cups, all filled slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈhʌndrəd kʌps ɔl fɪld ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 一百個杯子，每一個都倒得很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow is the only rule of this room.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ ɪz ði ˈoʊnli rul ʌv ðɪs rum./
dialogue.zh: 「慢」是這一間房唯一的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll carry that rule into the face room.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ˈkæri ðæt rul ˈɪntu ðə feɪs rum./
dialogue.zh: 我要把這條規矩帶進臉部按摩間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, she keeps it too, and no talking.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd ʃi kips ɪt tu ænd noʊ ˈtɔkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 好，她也守這條，還加上不說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No talking is exactly what I want.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈtɔkɪŋ ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt aɪ wɑnt./
dialogue.zh: 不說話，正是我現在最想要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you'll rest through the whole twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jʊl rɛst θru ðə hoʊl ˈtwɛnti./
dialogue.zh: 那你就會安安穩穩躺完那二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, blanket folded, cup back, robe tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈblæŋkɪt ˈfoʊldəd kʌp bæk roʊb taɪt./
dialogue.zh: 好，毯子摺好、杯子歸位、腰帶繫緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The green hall starts past the fountain door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡrin hɔl stɑrts pæst ðə ˈfaʊntən dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 綠色走廊就從噴泉那扇門開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Room four, the lamp is already on.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum fɔr ðə læmp ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 四號房的燈已經先亮著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ruth opens the door, she does faces here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ruθ ˈoʊpənz ðə dɔr ʃi dʌz ˈfeɪsɪz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 露絲會開門，她在這裡專門替人做臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello, I'm Lin, the ninety minute one.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛˈloʊ aɪm lɪn ðə ˈnaɪnti ˈmɪnɪt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 你好，我是林，約九十分鐘的那一位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hello Lin, lie back, the bed is warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛˈloʊ lɪn laɪ bæk ðə bɛd ɪz wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 你好林，往後躺，床是溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's warm like the tea bench, almost.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts wɔrm laɪk ðə ti bɛntʃ ˈɔlmoʊst./
dialogue.zh: 這個溫度幾乎跟喝茶那張椅子一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Low heat, it keeps the face relaxed.
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ hit ɪt kips ðə feɪs rɪˈlækst./
dialogue.zh: 熱壓得很低，讓整張臉鬆開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I leave my glasses on the table?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ liv maɪ ˈglæsɪz ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把眼鏡放在桌上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Case first, then under the small cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /keɪs fɜrst ðɛn ˈʌndər ðə smɔl klɔθ./
dialogue.zh: 先收進盒子，再放到那塊小布底下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this soft band for my hair?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs sɔft bænd fɔr maɪ hɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 這條軟帶是用來綁頭髮的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It holds the edges back, no cream there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hoʊldz ði ˈɛdʒɪz bæk noʊ krim ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 它把邊的碎髮固定住，霜就不會沾到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I choose which oil we use?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ tʃuz wɪtʃ ɔɪl wi juz?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以自己挑要用哪一種油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almond, lavender, or one with orange peel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑmənd ˈlævəndər ɔr wʌn wɪð ˈɔrɪndʒ pil./
dialogue.zh: 甜杏仁、薰衣草，或者加橙皮的那款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lavender, it's the one I brought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlævəndər ɪts ðə wʌn aɪ brɔt./
dialogue.zh: 薰衣草，就是我自己帶來這一瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll warm it, palms first, then your face.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl wɔrm ɪt pɑmz fɜrst ðɛn jɔr feɪs./
dialogue.zh: 我先把它溫熱，倒在掌心，再碰你的臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm hands make the first touch easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm hændz meɪk ðə fɜrst tʌtʃ ˈizi./
dialogue.zh: 手掌是暖的，第一次碰臉就輕鬆多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, cold hands stay in the locker room.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs koʊld hændz steɪ ɪn ðə ˈlɑkər rum./
dialogue.zh: 對，冰的手會留在寄物櫃那一區。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you clean the face first?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju klin ðə feɪs fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 你們會先替我把臉清乾淨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always, warm cloth, two circles only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlˌweɪz wɔrm klɔθ tu ˈsɜrkəlz ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 一定會，用溫布，只畫兩個圓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your hands move very slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr hændz muv ˈvɛri ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 你的手動得特別特別慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow tells the jaw to let go.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ tɛlz ðə dʒɔ tə lɛt ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 慢，是在告訴你的下巴放開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turns out my jaw is tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrnz aʊt maɪ dʒɔ ɪz taɪt./
dialogue.zh: 原來我的下巴一直繃得緊緊的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone carries it, ten years of talking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌwʌn ˈkæriz ɪt tɛn jɪrz ʌv ˈtɔkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 每個人這裡都緊，那是講了十年話的結果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you use less on the jaw?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju juz lɛs ɑn ðə dʒɔ?/
dialogue.zh: 下巴那一邊可以輕一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lighter now, tell me if it slips back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlaɪtər naʊ tɛl mi ɪf ɪt slɪps bæk./
dialogue.zh: 現在輕了，如果又變重請告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is good, right on the ear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz gʊd raɪt ɑn ði ɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這樣剛好，就在耳朵下方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under it, then along the neck, slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər ɪt ðɛn əˈlɔŋ ðə nɛk ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 再往下一點，然後順著頸走，慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The forehead part is my favorite.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈfɔrˌhɛd pɑrt ɪz maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt./
dialogue.zh: 額頭那一段是我最喜歡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small circles above the brows, then out.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ˈsɜrkəlz əˈbʌv ðə braʊz ðɛn aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 眉毛上方畫小圓圈，然後往外推。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now my temples feel like they unlock.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ maɪ ˈtɛmpəlz fil laɪk ðeɪ ˈʌnˌlɑk./
dialogue.zh: 現在我的太陽穴像被打開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the day leaving, keep your eyes shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə deɪ ˈlivɪŋ kip jɔr aɪz ʃʌt./
dialogue.zh: 那是一整天的壓力在離開，眼睛繼續閉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to talk while you work?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə tɔk waɪl ju wɜrk?/
dialogue.zh: 你做事的時候我也需要講話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only hum, yes or no, nothing else.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli hʌm jɛs ɔr noʊ ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls./
dialogue.zh: 只要嗯一聲，是或不，其他都不用說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The oil smell fills the whole small room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɔɪl smɛl fɪlz ðə hoʊl smɔl rum./
dialogue.zh: 精油的味道把這間小屋整個填滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close your eyes, the scent stays for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz jɔr aɪz ðə sɛnt steɪz fɔr ju./
dialogue.zh: 閉上眼睛，味道會留下來陪你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I just sleep for one second?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd aɪ dʒʌst slip fɔr wʌn ˈsɛkənd?/
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛是不是睡了一下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three, I counted, it's a good sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri aɪ ˈkaʊntɪd ɪts ə gʊd saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 三秒，我有數，這是好現象。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's the cool layer on my cheeks?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts ðə kul ˈleɪər ɑn maɪ tʃiːks?/
dialogue.zh: 我頰上那層涼涼的是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A sheet mask, ten minutes, don't move.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ʃit mæsk tɛn ˈmɪnɪts doʊnt muv./
dialogue.zh: 一片敷面布，十分鐘，請別動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It feels like cold water sitting still.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt filz laɪk koʊld ˈwɔtər ˈsɪtɪŋ stɪl./
dialogue.zh: 它像一池靜靜的水停在臉上一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's it doing its quiet work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɪt duɪŋ ɪts ˈkwaɪət wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 就是它正在安靜地做它的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Funny, my chin is the coldest part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfʌni maɪ tʃɪn ɪz ðə ˈkoʊldɪst pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 好奇怪，我的下巴是最涼的一塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chin always waits its turn here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃɪn ˈɔlˌweɪz weɪts ɪts tɜrn hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 在下巴這裡，它一定最後才輪到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I hold still the whole ten?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ hoʊld stɪl ðə hoʊl tɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 整十分鐘我都要保持一動不動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, one small swallow is allowed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst wʌn smɔl ˈswɑloʊ ɪz əˈlaʊd./
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，小小地吞一下是可以的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a towel under my neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈtaʊəl ˈʌndər maɪ nɛk./
dialogue.zh: 我頸下墊著一條捲起來的毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rolled, it keeps the shoulders off the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊld ɪt kips ðə ˈʃoʊldərz ɔf ðə bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 捲起來撐著，肩膀就不必壓在床面上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lamp light is off my eyes now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læmp laɪt ɪz ɔf maɪ aɪz naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 燈的光現在照不到我的眼睛了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It points at the wall, not at you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt pɔɪnts æt ðə wɔl nɑt æt ju./
dialogue.zh: 它對準的是牆，不是對著你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should my hands be right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd maɪ hændz bi raɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我的兩手現在該擺在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest them open, palms up, on the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst ðɛm ˈoʊpən pɑmz ʌp ɑn ðə bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 攤開就好，掌心朝上，擱在床邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Palms up feels like a lot of trust.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɑmz ʌp filz laɪk ə lɑt ʌv trʌst./
dialogue.zh: 掌心朝上，有一種把什麼交出去的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, the face room asks for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ðə feɪs rum æskz fɔr ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 就是如此，做臉的房間需要這一點信任。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the neck part already finished?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə nɛk pɑrt ɔlˈrɛdi ˈfɪnɪʃt?/
dialogue.zh: 頸部那一段是已經做完了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half now, half after the mask comes off.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf naʊ hæf ˈæftər ðə mæsk kʌmz ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 現在做一半，剩下等敷面布拿掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mask cools even the tip of my nose.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mæsk kuls ˈivən ðə tɪp ʌv maɪ noʊz./
dialogue.zh: 連鼻尖都被那片布涼到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The nose rests last, then we wipe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə noʊz rɛsts læst ðɛn wi waɪp./
dialogue.zh: 鼻子最後才安定，然後我們擦乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you wipe it with a warm cloth?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju waɪp ɪt wɪð ə wɔrm klɔθ?/
dialogue.zh: 你會用溫布幫我把它擦掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool cloth first, then a soft dry one.
dialogue.phonetic: /kul klɔθ fɜrst ðɛn ə sɔft draɪ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 先用涼布，再用一條柔軟乾毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Truly, my face feels clean and very light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtruːli maɪ feɪs filz klin ænd ˈvɛri laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 真的，我的臉現在覺得很乾淨、很輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Light is exactly how it should feel.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪt ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli haʊ ɪt ʃʊd fil./
dialogue.zh: 輕，就是它本來該給你的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I sit up, or still ten seconds?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ sɪt ʌp ɔr stɪl tɛn ˈsɛkəndz?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以坐起來了嗎，還是再十秒？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit slow, the room will spin a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt sloʊ ðə rum wil spɪn ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢坐，房間會稍微轉一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I see the mirror a little?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ si ðə ˈmɪrər ə ˈlɪtəl?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以稍微照一下鏡子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, the glow needs five more.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt ðə ɡloʊ nidz faɪv mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 還不行，那層光需要再多五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is glow the word you use here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɡloʊ ðə wɜrd ju juz hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 「光」是你們在這裡用的那個詞嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm blood near the skin, that's all it is.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm blʌd nɪr ðə skɪn ðæts ɔl ɪt ɪz./
dialogue.zh: 就是血流靠近皮膚，僅此而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take the head band off?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ teɪk ðə hɛd bænd ɔf?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把束髮帶拿下來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and pull it forward, not up.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd pʊl ɪt ˈfɔrwərd nɑt ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 可以，往前拉下來，別往上扯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the oil stays on my face?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə ɔɪl steɪz ɑn maɪ feɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 所以那層油今晚會一直留在臉上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tonight yes, wash it in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt jɛs wɑʃ ɪt ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 今晚留著，早上再洗掉它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just water in the morning, or soap?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈwɔtər ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ ɔr soʊp?/
dialogue.zh: 早上只用清水，還是也能用肥皂？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water, and the cedar bar if you must.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər ænd ðə ˈsidər bɑr ɪf ju mʌst./
dialogue.zh: 清水就好，真覺得膩才用那條雪松皂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I drink more water tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ drɪŋk mɔr ˈwɔtər təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我今天晚上需要多喝水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two cups, the mask asked a lot of you.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu kʌps ðə mæsk æskt ə lɑt ʌv ju./
dialogue.zh: 兩杯，那片布今晚上用掉了你不少水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the redness normal, on my cheeks?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈrɛdnəs ˈnɔrməl ɑn maɪ tʃiːks?/
dialogue.zh: 我頰上那片泛紅是正常的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little pink, it goes by nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl pɪŋk ɪt ɡoʊz baɪ naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 一點粉紅，九點以前就會退。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine, that's the closing hour again.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ðæts ðə ˈkloʊzɪŋ ˈaʊər əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 九點，又是關門的那個時間了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, so lie back, nobody will rush you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs soʊ laɪ bæk ˈnoʊbədi wɪl rʌʃ ju./
dialogue.zh: 是啊，所以你就躺著，沒有人會催你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lie? I could stay on this bed forever.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪ aɪ kʊd steɪ ɑn ðɪs bɛd fərˈɛvər./
dialogue.zh: 躺？我可以在這張床上躺一輩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll leave the lamp, take five more, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl liv ðə læmp teɪk faɪv mɔr pliːz./
dialogue.zh: 我把燈留給你，再多躺五分鐘吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five minutes here is a gift, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈmɪnɪts hɪr ɪz ə ɡɪft ˈtruːli./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡的這種五分鐘，真的是一份禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's yours, the hour is not finished yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts jɔrz ði ˈaʊər ɪz nɑt ˈfɪnɪʃt jɛt./
dialogue.zh: 這是你的時間，這一小時還沒走完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did you do for the brows?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dɪd ju du fɔr ðə braʊz?/
dialogue.zh: 你剛剛對我的眉毛做了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only oil and slow thumbs, no tool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɔɪl ænd sloʊ θʌmz noʊ tul./
dialogue.zh: 只有油和慢慢的大拇指，沒有工具。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do my brows look different to you?
dialogue.phonetic: /du maɪ braʊz lʊk ˈdɪfərənt tə ju?/
dialogue.zh: 你覺得我的眉毛看起來不一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Resting, that's the whole trick, nothing else.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛstɪŋ ðæts ðə hoʊl trɪk ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls./
dialogue.zh: 只是鬆下來了，這就是全部的訣竅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My neck still carries a little oil.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ nɛk stɪl ˈkæriz ə ˈlɪtəl ɔɪl./
dialogue.zh: 我的頸後還留著一點點油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it, it feeds the skin all evening.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt ɪt fidz ðə skɪn ɔl ˈivnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 讓它留著，整個傍晚它都在養皮膚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All evening, then one long sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ˈivnɪŋ ðɛn wʌn lɔŋ slip./
dialogue.zh: 整個傍晚，然後一夜長眠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tonight will be deep, the plunge sees to that.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt wil bi dip ðə plʌndʒ siːz tə ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 今晚會睡得很深，那池冷水有這份本領。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bed hums under me, so quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛd hʌmz ˈʌndər mi soʊ ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 床在我身下輕輕作響，很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the new mattress, it hushes everyone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə nu ˈmætrɪs ɪt ˈhʊʃɪz ˈɛvriˌwʌn./
dialogue.zh: 是那張新床墊，它讓每個人都沒了聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hear the tea counter far below me.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɪr ðə ti ˈkaʊntər fɑr bɪˈloʊ mi./
dialogue.zh: 我聽到樓下倒茶那張台還在動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chairs move, the pot pours, that's all.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛrz muv ðə pɑt pɔrz ðæts ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 椅子在移動、壺在倒，就只有這些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing I have to answer right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ aɪ hæv tə ˈænsər raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 沒有任何事情需要我現在回答。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, you have four more minutes left.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ju hæv fɔr mɔr ˈmɪnɪts lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，你還有四分鐘可以躺著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four minutes, I'll spend them lying here.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈmɪnɪts aɪl spɛnd ðɛm ˈlaɪɪŋ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 四分鐘，我要用躺著的方式把它花掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ruth writes a note, then slips out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ruθ raɪts ə noʊt ðɛn slɪps aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 露絲留了一張字條，然後輕輕走出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The door closed, and nobody said a word.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɔr kloʊzd ænd ˈnoʊˌbɑdi sɛd ə wɜrd./
dialogue.zh: 門關上了，沒有一個人說一個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's how a good face room ends, softly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts haʊ ə gʊd feɪs rum ɛndz ˈsɔftli./
dialogue.zh: 一間好的做臉房就是這樣結束，很輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lamp, the bed, and me, nobody else.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læmp ðə bɛd ænd mi ˈnoʊˌbɑdi ɛls./
dialogue.zh: 一盞燈、一張床、還有我，沒有別人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ruth's note says, rest as long as you can.
dialogue.phonetic: /ruθs noʊt sɛz rɛst æz lɔŋ æz ju kæn./
dialogue.zh: 露絲的字條寫著，能躺多久就躺多久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: As long as I can, that's an order.
dialogue.phonetic: /æz lɔŋ æz aɪ kæn ðæts ən ˈɔrdər./
dialogue.zh: 能躺多久就多久，這根本是命令。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bed is warm, the hall is not.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛd ɪz wɔrm ðə hɔl ɪz nɑt./
dialogue.zh: 床是暖的，外面那條走廊可不是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My arms and legs feel like warm water.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ɑrmz ænd lɛɡz fil laɪk wɔrm ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 我的手臂和腿像溫水一樣軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay, the tea can wait ten more.
dialogue.phonetic: /steɪ ðə ti kæn weɪt tɛn mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 留著吧，那杯茶可以再多等你十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten more, then I'll move one arm.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn mɔr ðɛn aɪl muv wʌn ɑrm./
dialogue.zh: 那再十分鐘，然後我動一隻手臂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One arm is a real plan here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɑrm ɪz ə ril plæn hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，動一隻手臂就算是完整的計畫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there any hurry left in this room?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ˈɛni ˈhɜri lɛft ɪn ðɪs rum?/
dialogue.zh: 這間房裡還有殘留一點匆忙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None; nine belongs to the desk, not here.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌn naɪn bɪˈlɔŋz tə ðə dɛsk nɑt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 沒有；九點是櫃台的時間，不是這裡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even my own voice sounds far away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivɪn maɪ oʊn vɔɪs saʊndz fɑr əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 就連我自己的聲音，聽起來都像來自很遠的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Speak small, the walls are thin and kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /spik smɔl ðə wɔlz ɑr θɪn ænd kaɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 小聲說話就好，牆很薄，但很客氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I still don't want to open my eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ stɪl doʊnt wɑnt tə ˈoʊpən maɪ aɪz./
dialogue.zh: 我還是不要把眼睛睜開比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then don't, the mirror will wait outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn doʊnt ðə ˈmɪrər wil weɪt ˌaʊtˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 那就別睜，鏡子會在外面等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ruth left one card by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ruθ lɛft wʌn kɑrd baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 露絲在門邊留了一張小卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It reads, sleep well tonight, in small print.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ridz slip wɛl təˈnaɪt ɪn smɔl prɪnt./
dialogue.zh: 上面寫著，今晚睡好，字很小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep well, that's a kind thing to write.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip wɛl ðæts ə kaɪnd θɪŋ tə raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 「今晚睡好」，這是很溫柔的一句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We write it on every face card.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi raɪt ɪt ɑn ˈɛvri feɪs kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 我們每張做臉的卡片都這樣寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now one arm, then the other, slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wʌn ɑrm ðɛn ði ˈʌðər ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 現在先起一隻手臂，再來另一隻，慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit, put your feet on the warm mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt pʊt jɔr fit ɑn ðə wɔrm mæt./
dialogue.zh: 坐起來，把腳放到溫熱的墊子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The floor is cooler than the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə flɔr ɪz ˈkulər ðæn ðə bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 地板比床面涼了一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand when your head agrees with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd wɛn jɔr hɛd əˈɡriz wɪθ ju./
dialogue.zh: 等你的頭跟你商量好了，再站起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My head agrees, my head is lazy.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hɛd əˈɡriz maɪ hɛd ɪz ˈleɪzi./
dialogue.zh: 我的頭同意，不過我的頭很懶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then lean on the bed for one more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lin ɑn ðə bɛd fɔr wʌn mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 那就再靠回床上，多賴一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The robe falls open, I forget it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə roʊb fɔlz ˈoʊpən aɪ fərˈɡɛt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 袍子自己滑開了，我懶得管。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tie it, the hall air is moving.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪ ɪt ðə hɔl ɛr ɪz ˈmuvɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 繫好吧，走廊的風正在流動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Damp still, my hair behind the ears.
dialogue.phonetic: /dæmp stɪl maɪ hɛr bɪˈhaɪnd ði ɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 我耳朵後面的頭髮，現在還是濕濕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it dry, the night air will finish.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt draɪ ðə naɪt ɛr wil ˈfɪnɪʃ./
dialogue.zh: 讓它自己乾，外面的夜風會幫你收工。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At last the mirror, is that me?
dialogue.phonetic: /æt læst ðə ˈmɪrər ɪz ðæt mi?/
dialogue.zh: 終於照到鏡子了，那個人是我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's you, with a little more light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ju wɪð ə ˈlɪtəl mɔr laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 是你，只是多了一點光在臉上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: More light, and the lines are quieter.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔr laɪt ænd ðə laɪnz ɑr ˈkwaɪətər./
dialogue.zh: 光變多了，紋路也變得安靜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's what twenty quiet minutes will do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts wʌt ˈtwɛnti ˈkwaɪət ˈmɪnɪts wil du./
dialogue.zh: 那安靜的二十分鐘就是要做到這件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green hall, then stairs, then my locker.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrin hɔl ðɛn stɛrz ðɛn maɪ ˈlɑkər./
dialogue.zh: 綠色走廊，然後樓梯，然後我的櫃子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The band opens it, same as before.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bænd ˈoʊpənz ɪt seɪm æz bɪˈfɔr./
dialogue.zh: 手環貼一下就開，跟一開始一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My clothes are folded exactly where I left them.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kloʊz ɑr ˈfoʊldɪd ɪɡˈzæktli wɛr aɪ lɛft ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 我的衣服摺得好好的，就在我放的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We never move a guest's own pile.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈnɛvər muv ə ɡɛsts oʊn paɪl./
dialogue.zh: 我們從不亂動客人自己疊好的那一疊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Socks first, then shoes, then the coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɑks fɜrst ðɛn ʃuz ðɛn ðə koʊt./
dialogue.zh: 先穿襪子，再來是鞋，然後是外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dress slowly, the desk will keep one light.
dialogue.phonetic: /drɛs ˈsloʊli ðə dɛsk wil kip wʌn laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢穿，櫃台那邊會幫你留一盞燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right away my phone wakes up with forty messages.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt əˈweɪ maɪ foʊn weɪks ʌp wɪð ˈfɔrti ˈmɛsɪdʒɪz./
dialogue.zh: 我的手機立刻就開機亮起來，有四十則訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shut it again, the drive home is short.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʌt ɪt əˈɡɛn ðə draɪv hoʊm ɪz ʃɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 再關回去吧，回家的車程很短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Short, and I'll be too sleepy to drive.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɔrt ænd aɪl bi tu ˈslipi tə draɪv./
dialogue.zh: 是很短，但我可能會睏到開不了車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tea first, then you'll drive like a cloud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ti fɜrst ðɛn jʊl draɪv laɪk ə klaʊd./
dialogue.zh: 先喝一杯茶，然後你就會像雲一樣飄回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At the desk now, my band comes off.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ðə dɛsk naʊ maɪ bænd kʌmz ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 現在到了櫃台，我的手環要解開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's your ring, Lin; how was the cold water?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪrz jɔr rɪŋ lɪn haʊ wʌz ðə koʊld ˈwɔtər?/
dialogue.zh: 這是您的戒指，林；那池冷水感覺如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brave, I did it twice, I can't believe it.
dialogue.phonetic: /breɪv aɪ dɪd ɪt twaɪs aɪ kænt bɪˈliv ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我很勇敢，我下去了兩次，我自己都不敢信。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice is a record for a first day.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ɪz ə ˈrɛkərd fɔr ə fɜrst deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 頭一天就兩次，這已經是紀錄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the ninety minutes feel long?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə ˈnaɪnti ˈmɪnɪts fil lɔŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 九十分鐘感覺很長嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Long? You look sleepy, so no answer.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ ju lʊk ˈslipi soʊ noʊ ˈænsər./
dialogue.zh: 長？你看起來睏極了，那就別答了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take the chamomile packet, and soap.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk ðə kæˈmɑmɪl ˈpækɪt ænd soʊp./
dialogue.zh: 我要那包洋甘菊茶，還要一條皂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two bars of cedar, the small bags too?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu bɑrz ʌv ˈsidər ðə smɔl bæɡz tu?/
dialogue.zh: 兩條雪松皂，小茶包也要嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and the lavender oil, my own.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ðə ˈlævəndər ɔɪl maɪ oʊn./
dialogue.zh: 要，還有薰衣草精油，是我自己那瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is free, you brought the bottle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ɪz fri ju brɔt ðə ˈbɑtəl./
dialogue.zh: 那瓶不收錢，是你自己帶來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for the tea and the soap?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ fɔr ðə ti ænd ðə soʊp?/
dialogue.zh: 茶和皂一共要多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty four, and the receipt goes by mail.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti fɔr ænd ðə rɪˈsit ɡoʊz baɪ meɪl./
dialogue.zh: 二十四元，收據我們會用寄的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mail is good, my bag is too full.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪl ɪz gʊd maɪ bæɡ ɪz tu fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 寄著剛好，我的包已經塞太滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I keep a place for next Sunday?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kip ə pleɪs fɔr nɛkst ˈsʌndeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 下週日要不要再幫你留一個位子？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next Sunday, four thirty, the same whole plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst ˈsʌndeɪ fɔr ˈθɜrdi ðə seɪm hoʊl plæn./
dialogue.zh: 下週日四點半，完全同樣的流程。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, and I'll warm the robe this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ænd aɪl wɔrm ðə roʊb ðɪs taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 記好了，這次我會先把袍子溫熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I ask about the sauna hours?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ æsk əˈbaʊt ðə ˈsaʊnə ˈaʊərz?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以問一下桑拿的開放時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open till eight, the stones rest at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən tɪl eɪt ðə stoʊnz rɛst æt naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 開到八點，石塊九點就歇了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine, the same hour I go to sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ðə seɪm ˈaʊər aɪ ɡoʊ tə slip./
dialogue.zh: 九點，跟我要睡覺的時間一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the wish, sleep right after the drive.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə wɪʃ slip raɪt ˈæftər ðə draɪv./
dialogue.zh: 我們的願望就是讓你開回家以後倒頭就睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The garden gate, my coat, the cool air.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈgɑrdən geɪt maɪ koʊt ðə kul ɛr./
dialogue.zh: 花園小門、我的外套、還有一片涼的空氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine degrees outside, and you are warm through.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn dɪˈɡriz ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ænd ju ɑr wɔrm θru./
dialogue.zh: 外面九度，而你從裡到外都是暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pines look the same, but softer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə paɪnz lʊk ðə seɪm bʌt ˈsɔftər./
dialogue.zh: 松樹看起來還是那些，卻柔軟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your eyes are doing that, not the pines.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr aɪz ɑr duɪŋ ðæt nɑt ðə paɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 那是你的眼睛在改變，不是松樹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See, my shoulders are down from my ears.
dialogue.phonetic: /si maɪ ˈʃoʊldərz ɑr daʊn frʌm maɪ ɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 你看，我的肩膀終於從耳邊落了下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the ninety minutes walking out with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈnaɪnti ˈmɪnɪts ˈwɔkɪŋ aʊt wɪð ju./
dialogue.zh: 那九十分鐘正跟著你一起走出門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The stone step, then the small parking lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stoʊn stɛp ðɛn ðə smɔl ˈpɑrkɪŋ lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 下那階石階，然後是小小的停車場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drive home slow, and drink the two cups.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪv hoʊm sloʊ ænd drɪŋk ðə tu kʌps./
dialogue.zh: 車開慢一點，回家記得喝那兩杯水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two cups, then bed, then no alarm.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu kʌps ðɛn bɛd ðɛn noʊ əˈlɑrm./
dialogue.zh: 兩杯水，然後上床，然後不準設鬧鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No alarm, and Monday can wait a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ əˈlɑrm ænd ˈmʌndeɪ kæn weɪt ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不用鬧鐘，星期一的事可以稍等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The car door feels soft to my hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑr dɔr filz sɔft tə maɪ hænd./
dialogue.zh: 車門摸起來在我手裡特別柔軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest your hands, they held the rail today.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst jɔr hændz ðeɪ hɛld ðə reɪl təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 讓手歇著吧，它們今天抓過池邊的欄杆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I keep feeling the cold on my arms.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kip ˈfilɪŋ ðə koʊld ɑn maɪ ɑrmz./
dialogue.zh: 我手臂上還是留著那一點冷的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will fade by the time you're home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wil feɪd baɪ ðə taɪm jʊr hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 等你開到家，那點冷就會自己褪掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Home, then soup, and nothing else at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊm ðɛn sup ænd ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 到家，然後喝湯，別的什麼都不做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soup is warm, the face oil is warmer.
dialogue.phonetic: /sup ɪz wɔrm ðə feɪs ɔɪl ɪz ˈwɔrmər./
dialogue.zh: 湯是暖的，臉上那層油更暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll wash in the morning, like Ruth said.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl wɑʃ ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ laɪk ruθ sɛd./
dialogue.zh: 我會照露絲說的，早上再洗臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning, water only, and the cedar if needed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈwɔtər ˈoʊnli ænd ðə ˈsidər ɪf ˈnidəd./
dialogue.zh: 早上只用清水，真的需要才用雪松皂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One drop, and the pillow takes the scent.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn drɑp ænd ðə ˈpɪloʊ teɪks ðə sɛnt./
dialogue.zh: 才一滴，枕頭就把那個味道收走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's how the spa comes home with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts haʊ ðə spɑ kʌmz hoʊm wɪð ju./
dialogue.zh: 水療中心就是這樣跟你一起回家的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heavy eyes, but I'm still awake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛvi aɪz bʌt aɪm stɪl əˈweɪk./
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛很沉，但我還醒著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay awake one minute more, for the tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /steɪ əˈweɪk wʌn ˈmɪnɪt mɔr fɔr ðə ti./
dialogue.zh: 再撐一分鐘醒著，為了那最後一杯茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The last cup was the best of all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læst kʌp wʌz ðə bɛst ʌv ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 最後那杯茶，是所有杯裡最好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It always is, after heat and cold work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈɔlˌweɪz ɪz ˈæftər hit ænd koʊld wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 每回都是這樣，熱和冷做完工以後最好喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I lie here, and nothing is due.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ laɪ hɪr ænd ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪz du./
dialogue.zh: 我現在躺在這裡，什麼事都不必交。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing is due in bed, that's the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪz du ɪn bɛd ðæts ðə rul./
dialogue.zh: 躺在床上就沒有期限，這是這裡的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The face mask, the plunge, the tea, all done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə feɪs mæsk ðə plʌndʒ ðə ti ɔl dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 敷面布、冷水池、熱茶，全部做完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All done, so let your legs be heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl dʌn soʊ lɛt jɔr lɛɡz bi ˈhɛvi./
dialogue.zh: 都做完了，所以讓你的腿重一點吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heavy legs, warm hands, and a slow head.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛvi lɛɡz wɔrm hændz ænd ə sloʊ hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 腿很重、手很暖、腦袋很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A slow head is the finest thing tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə sloʊ hɛd ɪz ðə ˈfaɪnɪst θɪŋ təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 腦袋慢下來，是今晚最珍貴的一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I don't want to get up, is that bad?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ doʊnt wɑnt tə ɡɛt ʌp ɪz ðæt bæd?/
dialogue.zh: 我根本不想起床，這樣好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's the best answer of your whole day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ðə bɛst ˈænsər ʌv jɔr hoʊl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 這會是你今天最好的一個答案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'm staying right here a little longer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪm ˈsteɪɪŋ raɪt hɪr ə ˈlɪtəl ˈlɔŋɡər./
dialogue.zh: 那我就在這裡再多躺一會兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the night, the spa keeps the light off.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə naɪt ðə spɑ kips ðə laɪt ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 把整個夜晚拿去，這裡的燈會全部替你關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lamp is out, the pines are dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læmp ɪz aʊt ðə paɪnz ɑr dɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 燈熄了，窗外的松樹也暗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep now, we'll wash your cup in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip naʊ wil wɑʃ jɔr kʌp ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 睡吧，你的杯子我們早上會幫你洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, Ivy, good night, Ruth, good night.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd naɪt ˈaɪvi gʊd naɪt ruθ gʊd naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，艾薇；晚安，露絲；晚安。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, Lin, the cold pool will wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd naɪt lɪn ðə koʊld pul wil weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，林，那池冷水會等你回來。
